262:   }
263:   const report = await collect(process.cwd(), parsed.targetOptions);
264:   const fixes = parsed.flags.fix ? applyFixes(report) : null;

266:     process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({

268:       repoRoot: report.ctx.repoRoot,
269:       isMonorepo: report.ctx.isMonorepo,
270:       productPath: report.ctx.productPath,
271:       designPath: report.ctx.designPath,
272:       platform: report.ctx.platform,
273:       ruleRegistryAvailable: report.ruleRegistryAvailable,
274:       findings: report.findings,
275:       workspaces: report.workspaces,
276:       ...(fixes ? { fixes } : {}),

279:   }
280:   process.stdout.write(`${renderText(report, fixes)}\n`);
281: }
282: function invokedAsScript() {
283:   const arg = process.argv[1];

285:   try {
286:     return fs.realpathSync(arg) === fs.realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
287:   } catch {
288:     return false;
289:   }
290: }
291: if (invokedAsScript()) {
292:   cli().catch((err) => {
293:     process.stderr.write(`impeccable doctor failed: ${err?.message || err}\n`);
294:     process.exit(1);
295:   });
296: }

  2: // Embed a generation prompt into an image so the intent travels with the file,
  3: // across harnesses and machines. Read it back with --read.
  4: //
  5: //   node embed-prompt.mjs <image> --prompt "the prompt text"
  6: //   node embed-prompt.mjs <image> --prompt-file prompt.txt
  7: //   node embed-prompt.mjs <image> --read

  9: //
 10: // Formats: PNG (tEXt chunk, keyword "impeccable:prompt"), JPEG (COM segment).

 12: // the sidecar for every format, so the fallback stays recoverable. Embedding
 13: // rewrites a few MB at most: latency is milliseconds, generation is minutes.

  1: #!/usr/bin/env node
  2: /**
  3:  * font-match: measure the lettering in a comp's text region and rank candidate
  4:  * faces against it, so the face is chosen by metrics instead of by name.
  5:  *
  6:  *   node font-match.mjs --measure <region-id> [--spec .impeccable/build/spec.json]
  7:  *     Fingerprints the comp crop of a text region (lib/font-fingerprint.mjs):
  8:  *     cap height (px), glyph width per cap height (width class), stroke
  9:  *     density and stem width (weight class), tracking, plus the size-invariant
 10:  *     shape vector the ranking uses. Prints the summary and stores it on the
 11:  *     region in the spec (`type` block), so build code can set font-size from
 12:  *     capHeightPx and the hero gate can name a width/weight miss.
 13:  *
 14:  *   node font-match.mjs --rank <region-id> [--candidates "Barlow Condensed:700,Oswald:600"] [--text "The manuals stop."] [--category sans,display]
 15:  *     Candidates come from a fingerprint index of the Google Fonts catalog
 16:  *     (data/font-index.json, ~3,000 faces at two cap heights; the crop is
 17:  *     routed to the 14px or 48px index by its cap height): the 25 nearest
 18:  *     faces by fingerprint distance, plus the names you pass. Each candidate
 19:  *     is then rendered with the region's text at the comp's cap height in a
 20:  *     headless browser (Google Fonts CSS), fingerprinted the same way, and
 21:  *     ranked by the same distance on the rendered text. Prints CATALOG (the
 22:  *     index's top five), the ranking with per-face width and weight deltas,
 23:  *     a proof sheet, and the CSS to use (family, weight, and the font-size
 24:  *     that reproduces the comp's cap height). Needs a browser: playwright or
 25:  *     puppeteer resolvable from the project or the impeccable CLI; without
 26:  *     one, the CATALOG line is the ranking. Without the index the built-in
 27:  *     per-width-class shortlist stands in.
 28:  *
 29:  * Why: models pick faces from memory and never measure. Three of the six
 30:  * misses a human called on a first-round build were the same miss: the
 31:  * headline face wider and lighter than the comp's, the parts list smaller,
 32:  * the footer heavier. All three are ratios a script can read off pixels.
 33:  */
 34: import fs from 'node:fs';
 35: import path from 'node:path';
 36: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
 37: import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
 38: import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
 39: import { decodePng, encodePng, loadRaster } from './lib/png.mjs';
 40: import { crop } from './lib/raster.mjs';
 41: import { fingerprint, distance } from './lib/font-fingerprint.mjs';
 42: import { loadFontIndex, candidatesFromIndex, MIN_RANK_CAP_PX } from './lib/font-index.mjs';
 43: import { loadSpec, SPEC_PATH } from './comp-spec.mjs';
 44: const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
 45: function arg(name, fallback = null) {
 46:   const i = process.argv.indexOf(`--${name}`);
 47:   if (i === -1) return fallback;
 48:   const v = process.argv[i + 1];
 49:   return v && !v.startsWith('--') ? v : fallback;
 50: }
 51: // ---- fingerprint ----------------------------------------------------------
 52: // fingerprint(img) and distance(a, b) live in lib/font-fingerprint.mjs: size-

 54: // contrast, serif, density, ink profiles) and a noise-normalized weighted L1

 56: // those features into the words the MEASURE line prints.

 60:  * Thresholds sit on the catalog index (advX 0.20 quantile 0.58, median 0.64,
 61:  * 0.80 quantile 0.71) anchored by named faces: League Gothic 0.36, Oswald 0.42,
 62:  * Anton 0.48, Barlow Condensed 0.54, Roboto Condensed 0.58, Roboto 0.62,
 63:  * Inter 0.65, Space Grotesk 0.71, Montserrat Bold 0.76, Archivo Black 0.87.
 64:  */

111:  * (data/font-index.json) is missing; with the index, candidates come from
112:  * the comp's fingerprint and the model's own names.
113:  */
114: export const SHORTLIST = {
115:   compressed: ['League Gothic:400', 'Bebas Neue:400', 'Anton:400', 'Six Caps:400', 'Big Shoulders Display:900', 'Antonio:700', 'Saira Extra Condensed:800', 'Oswald:700'],
116:   condensed: ['League Gothic:400', 'Fjalla One:400', 'Anton:400', 'Bebas Neue:400', 'Oswald:600', 'Barlow Condensed:700', 'Roboto Condensed:800', 'Archivo Narrow:700', 'Pathway Gothic One:400', 'Big Shoulders Display:800', 'Teko:600', 'Sofia Sans Condensed:800'],
117:   normal: ['Inter:700', 'Work Sans:700', 'IBM Plex Sans:700', 'Archivo:800', 'Public Sans:700', 'Source Sans 3:700', 'Roboto:900', 'Barlow:800', 'Manrope:800', 'Rubik:800'],
118:   wide: ['Archivo Black:400', 'Syne:800', 'Space Grotesk:700', 'Unbounded:700', 'Bricolage Grotesque:800', 'Sora:800', 'Outfit:800', 'Lexend:800'],
119: };
120: /** Weight-shifted variants of a candidate list, one step lighter and heavier; the ranking decides. */
121: export function withWeightVariants(list) {
122:   const out = [];
123:   for (const c of list) {
124:     out.push(c);
125:     const m = /^(.*?):(\d{3})$/.exec(c);
126:     if (!m) continue;
127:     const w = parseInt(m[2], 10);
128:     for (const d of [-200, 200]) { const nw = w + d; if (nw >= 100 && nw <= 900) out.push(`${m[1]}:${nw}`); }
129:   }
130:   return [...new Set(out)];
131: }
132: /**
133:  * Candidate faces for a comp fingerprint: the nearest index faces (top n by
134:  * fingerprint distance, routed to the 14px or 48px index by the crop's cap
135:  * height, optionally filtered by category), the caller's own names first,
136:  * and the built-in shortlist only when there is no index. Returns
137:  * { candidates: [{ family, weight }], catalog: [index hits], source }.
138:  */
139: export function selectCandidates(fp, { own = [], index = null, n = 25, category = null } = {}) {
140:   const catalog = index ? candidatesFromIndex(fp, index, { n, category }) : [];
141:   const list = [...own, ...catalog.map((c) => ({ family: c.family, weight: c.weight }))];
142:   let source = 'index';
143:   if (!index) {
144:     source = 'shortlist';
145:     for (const s of withWeightVariants(SHORTLIST[widthClass(fp)] || SHORTLIST.normal)) list.push(parseCandidates(s)[0]);
146:   }
147:   const seen = new Set();
148:   const candidates = list.filter((c) => { const k = `${c.family}:${c.weight}`; if (seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; });
149:   return { candidates, catalog, source };
150: }
151: /**
152:  * A choice font-match wrote carries a stamp over its own fields, so the spec
153:  * gate can tell a measured choice from a hand-typed one. Sessions with no
154:  * browser wrote `"chosen": { "family": "Arial Narrow", "source": "system-fallback" }`
155:  * straight into spec.json to get past the gate; that is the guess the gate
156:  * exists to refuse. Not secret, just not something a model reaches for.
157:  */
158: export function stampChoice(regionId, chosen) {
159:   const h = createHash('sha1').update(`font-match:${regionId}:${chosen.family}:${chosen.weight}:${chosen.fontSizePx}:${chosen.source}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 12);
160:   return { ...chosen, stamp: h };
161: }
162: export function choiceStamped(regionId, chosen) {
163:   if (!chosen || !chosen.stamp) return false;
164:   return stampChoice(regionId, { ...chosen, stamp: undefined }).stamp === chosen.stamp;
165: }
166: // ---- browser --------------------------------------------------------------
167: /**
168:  * Playwright and puppeteer write launch artifacts to os.tmpdir(). In a
169:  * sandbox whose /tmp is not writable (the ninth sweep: EPERM on
170:  * mkdtemp /tmp/playwright-artifacts-*), every rank silently fell back to the
171:  * catalog and three of four builds set headlines at twice the comp's cap.
172:  * Probe once and point TMPDIR at a workspace dir when the system one fails.
173:  */
174: function ensureWritableTmp() {
175:   const os = require('node:os');
176:   try { const d = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'fm-')); fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); return; } catch { /* not writable */ }
177:   const local = path.resolve('.impeccable', 'tmp');
178:   try { fs.mkdirSync(local, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = local; process.env.TMP = local; process.env.TEMP = local; } catch { /* leave as is; launch will say why */ }
179: }
180: async function loadBrowser() {
181:   ensureWritableTmp();
182:   // IMPECCABLE_NODE_MODULES: a node_modules dir holding playwright or
183:   // puppeteer, for harnesses that mount the skill somewhere its own resolution
184:   // roots cannot see (a sandbox root, a plugin cache). NODE_PATH works too.
185:   const extra = (process.env.IMPECCABLE_NODE_MODULES || '').split(path.delimiter).filter(Boolean);
186:   const tries = [
187:     ...extra.map((dir) => () => require(require.resolve('playwright', { paths: [dir, path.dirname(dir)] }))),
188:     () => require('playwright'),
189:     () => require(require.resolve('playwright', { paths: [process.cwd()] })),
190:     () => require(require.resolve('playwright', { paths: [path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..')] })),
191:   ];
192:   for (const t of tries) { try { const pw = t(); if (pw?.chromium) return { kind: 'playwright', mod: pw }; } catch { /* next */ } }
193:   const tries2 = [
194:     ...extra.map((dir) => () => require(require.resolve('puppeteer', { paths: [dir, path.dirname(dir)] }))),
195:     () => require('puppeteer'),
196:     () => require(require.resolve('puppeteer', { paths: [process.cwd()] })),
197:     () => require(require.resolve('puppeteer', { paths: [path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..')] })),
198:   ];
199:   for (const t of tries2) { try { const pp = t(); if (pp?.launch) return { kind: 'puppeteer', mod: pp }; } catch { /* next */ } }
200:   return null;
201: }
202: function parseCandidates(s) {
203:   return String(s || '').split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((x) => {
204:     const m = /^(.*?)(?::(\d{3}))?$/.exec(x);
205:     return { family: m[1].trim(), weight: m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 400 };
206:   });
207: }
208: /** Render `text` in each candidate at a font-size whose measured cap height ~= targetCapPx; return fingerprints. */
209: export async function renderCandidates(candidates, text, targetCapPx, { transform = 'none' } = {}) {
210:   const b = await loadBrowser();
211:   if (!b) return null;
212:   // A resolvable module whose browser binary is absent (CI, a fresh install
213:   // without npx playwright install) throws at launch; that is the same
214:   // situation as no module, and the catalog fallback owns it.
215:   let browser;
216:   try { browser = b.kind === 'playwright' ? await b.mod.chromium.launch() : await b.mod.launch({ headless: true }); } catch { return null; }
217:   // One stylesheet per family+weight: a combined request 400s when any one
218:   // family lacks the requested axis (Anton has no wght range), and a static
219:   // family answers only for the weights it ships.
220:   const links = candidates.map((c) => `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${encodeURIComponent(c.family).replace(/%20/g, '+')}:wght@${c.weight}&display=block">`).join('');
221:   const html = `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">${links}<style>body{margin:0;background:#fff}div.s{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;white-space:nowrap;color:#000;line-height:1;padding:8px;text-transform:${transform}}</style></head><body></body></html>`;
222:   const results = [];
223:   const size0 = Math.max(12, Math.round(targetCapPx * 1.4));
224:   if (b.kind === 'playwright') {
225:     const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1600, height: 400 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
226:     await page.setContent(html, { waitUntil: 'load' });
227:     await page.waitForTimeout(800);
228:     for (const c of candidates) {
229:       // two passes: measure at size0, then rescale so the fingerprint's cap height matches the comp
230:       let size = size0, fp = null, ok = true;
231:       for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
232:         await page.evaluate(({ family, weight, size, text }) => {
233:           document.body.innerHTML = `<div class="s" style="font-family:'${family}',sans-serif;font-weight:${weight};font-size:${size}px">${text}</div>`;
234:         }, { family: c.family, weight: c.weight, size, text });
235:         let loaded = false;
236:         // Loaded means a real face of this family covers the requested weight;
237:         // fonts.check() answers true for a synthetic bold of a lighter file.
238:         try {
239:           loaded = await page.evaluate(async (f) => {
240:             const faces = await document.fonts.load(`${f.weight} 32px '${f.family}'`);
241:             await document.fonts.ready;
242:             const covers = (face) => { const w = String(face.weight || '400').split(/\s+/).map(Number); const lo = w[0], hi = w[1] ?? w[0]; return f.weight >= lo - 50 && f.weight <= hi + 50; };
243:             return faces.some((face) => face.family.replace(/["']/g, '') === f.family && face.status === 'loaded' && covers(face));
244:           }, c);
245:         } catch { loaded = false; }
246:         await page.waitForTimeout(100);
247:         if (!loaded) ok = false;
248:         const box = await page.evaluate(() => { const r = document.querySelector('div.s').getBoundingClientRect(); return { w: Math.ceil(r.width) + 8, h: Math.ceil(r.height) + 8 }; });
249:         const buf = await page.screenshot({ clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: Math.min(1600, box.w), height: Math.min(400, box.h) } });
250:         fp = fingerprint(decodePng(buf));
251:         if (!fp || pass === 1) break;
252:         size = Math.max(8, Math.round(size * (targetCapPx / fp.capHeightPx)));
253:       }
254:       results.push({ ...c, loaded: ok, fontSizePx: size, fp });
255:     }
256:     await browser.close();
257:   } else {
258:     const page = await browser.newPage();
259:     await page.setViewport({ width: 1600, height: 400 });
260:     await page.setContent(html, { waitUntil: 'load' });
261:     await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
262:     for (const c of candidates) {
263:       let size = size0, fp = null, ok = true;
264:       for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
265:         await page.evaluate(({ family, weight, size, text }) => {
266:           document.body.innerHTML = `<div class="s" style="font-family:'${family}',sans-serif;font-weight:${weight};font-size:${size}px">${text}</div>`;
267:         }, { family: c.family, weight: c.weight, size, text });
268:         let loaded = false;
269:         // Loaded means a real face of this family covers the requested weight;
270:         // fonts.check() answers true for a synthetic bold of a lighter file.
271:         try {
272:           loaded = await page.evaluate(async (f) => {
273:             const faces = await document.fonts.load(`${f.weight} 32px '${f.family}'`);
274:             await document.fonts.ready;
275:             const covers = (face) => { const w = String(face.weight || '400').split(/\s+/).map(Number); const lo = w[0], hi = w[1] ?? w[0]; return f.weight >= lo - 50 && f.weight <= hi + 50; };
276:             return faces.some((face) => face.family.replace(/["']/g, '') === f.family && face.status === 'loaded' && covers(face));
277:           }, c);
278:         } catch { loaded = false; }
279:         await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
280:         if (!loaded) ok = false;
281:         const box = await page.evaluate(() => { const r = document.querySelector('div.s').getBoundingClientRect(); return { w: Math.ceil(r.width) + 8, h: Math.ceil(r.height) + 8 }; });
282:         const buf = await page.screenshot({ clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: Math.min(1600, box.w), height: Math.min(400, box.h) } });
283:         fp = fingerprint(decodePng(buf));
284:         if (!fp || pass === 1) break;
285:         size = Math.max(8, Math.round(size * (targetCapPx / fp.capHeightPx)));
286:       }
287:       results.push({ ...c, loaded: ok, fontSizePx: size, fp });
288:     }
289:     await browser.close();
290:   }
291:   return results;
292: }
293: /** Comp crop over the top candidates, rendered at the comp's cap height, as one PNG. */
294: export async function renderProofSheet(compCrop, top, text, capPx, transform = 'none') {
295:   const b = await loadBrowser();
296:   if (!b || b.kind !== 'playwright') return null;
297:   const compB64 = Buffer.from(encodePng(compCrop)).toString('base64');
298:   const links = top.map((c) => `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${encodeURIComponent(c.family).replace(/%20/g, '+')}:wght@${c.weight}&display=block">`).join('');
299:   const rowsHtml = top.map((c) => `<div class="row"><div class="lab">${c.family} ${c.weight} · ${c.fontSizePx}px</div><div class="s" style="font-family:'${c.family}';font-weight:${c.weight};font-size:${c.fontSizePx}px;text-transform:${transform}">${text}</div></div>`).join('');
300:   const html = `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">${links}<style>body{margin:0;background:#fff;padding:12px;font-family:system-ui}img{display:block;max-width:100%}.lab{font:12px system-ui;color:#666;margin:10px 0 2px}.s{white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.05;color:#111}</style></head><body><div class="lab">COMP</div><img src="data:image/png;base64,${compB64}">${rowsHtml}</body></html>`;
301:   let browser;
302:   try { browser = await b.mod.chromium.launch(); } catch { return null; }
303:   const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: Math.min(1600, Math.max(600, compCrop.width + 24)), height: 200 } });
304:   await page.setContent(html, { waitUntil: 'load' });
305:   try { await page.evaluate(async () => { await document.fonts.ready; }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
306:   await page.waitForTimeout(600);
307:   const buf = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true });
308:   await browser.close();
309:   return buf;
310: }
311: // ---- CLI ------------------------------------------------------------------
312: function describe(fp) {
313:   const wm = widthMeasure(fp), wt = weightMeasure(fp);
314:   const wmS = wm ? ` (${wm.key} ${wm.value})` : '';
315:   const wtS = wt ? ` (${wt.key} ${wt.value})` : '';
316:   return `capHeight ${fp.capHeightPx}px, width ${widthClass(fp)}${wmS}, weight ${weightClass(fp)}${wtS}, tracking ${fp.gap}${fp.allCaps ? ', all caps' : ''}`;
317: }
318: /** Fingerprint fields the spec keeps for a region: the class-bearing features plus the shape summary, not the whole vector. */
319: function compactFp(fp) {
320:   if (!fp) return fp;
321:   const keep = ['lines', 'glyphs', 'capHeightPx', 'inkIsDark', 'allCaps', 'advance', 'advTall', 'advX', 'gap', 'xRatio', 'stemW', 'contrast', 'serif', 'densTall', 'densX', 'weight'];
322:   const out = {};
323:   for (const k of keep) if (fp[k] !== undefined) out[k] = fp[k];
324:   return out;
325: }
326: async function main() {
327:   const specPath = arg('spec', SPEC_PATH);
328:   const spec = loadSpec(specPath);
329:   const measureId = arg('measure'), rankId = arg('rank');
330:   const id = measureId || rankId;
331:   if (!id) {
332:     console.error('usage: font-match.mjs --measure <text-region-id> | --rank <text-region-id> [--candidates "Family:700,Family2:400,..."] [--text "..."] [--transform uppercase] [--category sans,serif,display,handwriting,mono]');
333:     process.exit(1);
334:   }
335:   if (!spec) { console.error(`font-match: no spec at ${specPath}; run comp-spec.mjs first`); process.exit(1); }
336:   const region = spec.regions.find((r) => r.id === id);
337:   if (!region) { console.error(`font-match: no region ${id}; ids: ${spec.regions.map((r) => r.id).join(', ')}`); process.exit(1); }
338:   const comp = loadRaster(spec.comp).image;
339:   const c = crop(comp, region.px.x, region.px.y, region.px.w, region.px.h);
340:   const fp = fingerprint(c);
341:   if (!fp) {
342:     // Record the attempt so the spec gate does not ask again; a region with
343:     // no separable glyphs (a rule, a bar of solid ink, a very small label at
344:     // comp resolution) is measured as "no lettering" and the model sizes it
345:     // by its box.
346:     region.type = { ...(region.type || {}), comp: null, measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(), note: 'no separable lettering in the crop; size by the region box' };
347:     fs.writeFileSync(specPath, JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2));
348:     console.log(`MEASURE ${id}: no separable lettering in the region crop at comp resolution; size this text by its box (${region.px.w}x${region.px.h}px) and inherit face and weight from the nearest measured region.`);
349:     process.exit(0);
350:   }
351:   region.type = { ...(region.type || {}), comp: compactFp(fp), widthClass: widthClass(fp), weightClass: weightClass(fp) };
352:   fs.writeFileSync(specPath, JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2));
353:   console.log(`MEASURE ${id}: ${describe(fp)} over ${fp.lines} line${fp.lines === 1 ? '' : 's'}, ${fp.glyphs} glyphs. Set this region's font-size so its cap height renders at ${fp.capHeightPx}px; choose a ${widthClass(fp)} ${weightClass(fp)} face.`);
354:   if (!rankId) return;
355:   if (fp.capHeightPx < MIN_RANK_CAP_PX) {
356:     console.log(`RANK skipped: cap height ${fp.capHeightPx}px is under ${MIN_RANK_CAP_PX}px, too small at comp resolution for a face fingerprint to mean anything. Size this text by its box (${region.px.w}x${region.px.h}px) and inherit face and weight from the nearest measured region.`);
357:     return;
358:   }
359:   const own = parseCandidates(arg('candidates'));
360:   const index = loadFontIndex();
361:   const { candidates, catalog, source } = selectCandidates(fp, { own, index, n: 25, category: arg('category') });
362:   if (index) {
363:     const top5 = []; for (const h of catalog) { if (!top5.some((t) => t.family === h.family)) top5.push(h); if (top5.length >= 5) break; }
364:     console.log(`CATALOG top-5 by fingerprint: ${top5.map((t) => `${t.family}:${t.weight}`).join(', ')} (from ${index.entries.length} indexed faces${catalog[0] ? `, ${catalog[0].size}px index` : ''}${arg('category') ? `, category ${arg('category')}` : ''})`);
365:     console.log(`CANDIDATES ${candidates.length}: ${own.length} yours + ${candidates.length - own.length} nearest in the catalog index`);
366:   } else {
367:     console.log(`CANDIDATES ${candidates.length}: ${own.length} yours + ${candidates.length - own.length} from the ${widthClass(fp)} shortlist (no catalog index at data/font-index.json)`);
368:   }
369:   const text = arg('text') || region.text || 'The manuals stop. The forum keeps going.';
370:   const transform = arg('transform', fp.allCaps ? 'uppercase' : 'none');
371:   const results = await renderCandidates(candidates, text, fp.capHeightPx, { transform });
372:   if (!results) {
373:     // No browser: the catalog fingerprint index is the ranking. Its top hit is
374:     // recorded as the chosen face (source `catalog`) so the spec gate has a
375:     // measured choice to close on; without this the gate refused forever and
376:     // sessions forced past it or spent ten turns installing Playwright.
377:     // font-size is estimated from the cap height at a 0.70 cap/em ratio, the
378:     // sans display median; the NOTE says to check one rendered word.
379:     if (index && catalog[0]) {
380:       const best = catalog[0];
381:       const fontSizePx = Math.round(fp.capHeightPx / 0.70);
382:       console.log(`RANK unavailable: no browser (playwright or puppeteer) resolvable from this project or the impeccable CLI; the CATALOG order stands as the ranking.`);
383:       console.log(`USE font-family: '${best.family}'; font-weight: ${best.weight}; font-size: ${fontSizePx}px;${transform !== 'none' ? ` text-transform: ${transform};` : ''} NOTE font-size is estimated (cap ${fp.capHeightPx}px / 0.70); render one headline word at that size, compare its cap height to the comp crop, and correct the size before building on it.`);
384:       region.type.chosen = stampChoice(id, { family: best.family, weight: best.weight, fontSizePx, source: 'catalog', estimatedSize: true });
385:       fs.writeFileSync(specPath, JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2));
386:       return;
387:     }
388:     console.log(`RANK unavailable: no browser (playwright or puppeteer) resolvable from this project or the impeccable CLI, and no catalog index. Choose by the MEASURE line: match the width class first, then the weight class; render one headline word against the comp before building on it.`);
389:     return;
390:   }
391:   // Drop faces that never loaded (a weight the family does not ship falls
392:   // back to a system face and would rank as that face), then collapse
393:   // duplicate renders (two requested weights that resolved to one file).
394:   const seenFp = new Set();
395:   const rows = results
396:     .filter((r) => r.fp && r.loaded)
397:     .map((r) => ({ ...r, d: distance(fp, r.fp) }))
398:     .filter((r) => Number.isFinite(r.d))
399:     .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d)
400:     .filter((r) => { const k = `${r.family}|${r.fp.advX}|${r.fp.advTall}|${r.fp.densTall}|${r.fp.stemW}`; if (seenFp.has(k)) return false; seenFp.add(k); return true; });
401:   const dropped = results.filter((r) => !r.loaded).map((r) => `${r.family}:${r.weight}`);
402:   if (dropped.length) console.log(`SKIPPED (not available at that weight on Google Fonts): ${dropped.join(', ')}`);
403:   const wm = widthMeasure(fp), wt = weightMeasure(fp);
404:   const pctDelta = (m, other) => { if (!m || other?.[m.key] == null) return null; return (other[m.key] - m.value) / m.value; };
405:   const fmtPct = (v) => (v == null ? 'n/a' : `${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(v * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);
406:   for (const r of rows) {
407:     console.log(`RANK ${r.family}:${r.weight} distance ${r.d.toFixed(3)}  width ${widthClass(r.fp)} (${fmtPct(pctDelta(wm, r.fp))} ${wm?.key || 'advance'})  weight ${weightClass(r.fp)} (${fmtPct(pctDelta(wt, r.fp))} ${wt?.key || 'ink'})  font-size ${r.fontSizePx}px for cap ${fp.capHeightPx}px`);
408:   }
409:   // proof sheet: comp crop over the top three renders, so the choice is seen, not only scored
410:   try {
411:     const top = rows.slice(0, 3);
412:     const sheet = await renderProofSheet(c, top, text, fp.capHeightPx, transform);
413:     if (sheet) {
414:       const out = path.join(path.dirname(specPath), 'font-match', `${id}.png`);
415:       fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
416:       fs.writeFileSync(out, sheet);
417:       console.log(`PROOF ${out} (comp crop, then the top ${top.length} candidates at the comp's cap height; open it before choosing)`);
418:     }
419:   } catch { /* proof sheet is best-effort */ }
420:   const best = rows[0];
421:   if (best) {
422:     const advice = [];
423:     const dw = pctDelta(wm, best.fp), dwt = pctDelta(wt, best.fp);
424:     if (dw != null && Math.abs(dw) > 0.1) advice.push(dw > 0 ? 'still too wide: try a more condensed face or a variable font with a wdth axis' : 'still too narrow: try a wider face');
425:     // a weight step only helps on a family that ships one; a single-cut display face is what it is
426:     const bestEntry = index?.entries.find((e) => e.family === best.family);
427:     const variable = bestEntry ? bestEntry.variable : true;
428:     if (dwt != null && Math.abs(dwt) > 0.15 && variable) advice.push(dwt > 0 ? `too heavy: drop to weight ${Math.max(100, best.weight - 200)}` : `too light: raise to weight ${Math.min(900, best.weight + 200)}`);

1577: const STEER_LINE = 'That does not mean the design is good: keep following the project design system and the impeccable skill guidance.';

1592: export function shouldEmitAckForFile(filePath, config = null) {

1607:   }
1608: }
1609: const DESIGN_STALE_NOTE = `${ENVELOPE_PREFIX} DESIGN.md is newer than .impeccable/design.json. Run ${IMPECCABLE_COMMAND} document to refresh the design-system sidecar.`;

1625: }
1626: // Once-per-session variant of appendDesignSystemNote for the emission paths

1650: // Full directive footer once per session, the short reminder after. Fresh

1667: const HOOK_ADMIN_COMMAND = `node ${quoteCommandArg(path.join(__dirname, 'hook-admin.mjs'))}`;

1674: //      documented bad design, user-confirmed choice) because the agent now
1675: //      acts on its own confidence and needs the bar stated.
1676: //   3. **Executable ignore path.** The old footer named only the slash

1693:   }
1694:   return [
1695:     'Triage each finding, then state in your reply what you fixed, what you suppressed, and what you left standing:',

1697:     `- Confident false positive or sanctioned exception (an intentional demo or fixture, documentation of bad design, literal or domain-appropriate motion, a choice the user confirmed): persist the narrowest ignore yourself and disclose it. Run \`${HOOK_ADMIN_COMMAND} ignore-value <rule> "<value>" --reason "<who decided: evidence>"\` with the pair shown on the finding line, or value "*" plus \`--file <path>\` when the line shows none.  1: #!/usr/bin/env node
 2: /**
 3:  * Impeccable design hook — PostToolUse + Stop entry point.
 4:  *
 5:  * Reads the Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Grok Build hook event from stdin
 6:  * and routes by Stop vs everything else. Claude uses `hook_event_name:
 7:  * "Stop"`; Grok uses `hookEventName: "stop"`.
 8:  *
 9:  *   - PostToolUse: runs the immediate-tier detector rules against the touched
10:  *     file and emits a system reminder via
11:  *     `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` when findings exist. Grok
12:  *     discards that stdout; the scan still warms the session cache for Stop.
13:  *   - Stop: runs the FULL detector rule set over every UI file touched this
14:  *     session (the deep pass), deduped against what the per-edit pass already
15:  *     surfaced, and emits once via the harness-specific continuation channel.
16:  *
17:  * Contract: never break a turn. Always exit 0. Clean files emit a small ack
18:  * unless quiet mode is enabled; a clean Stop pass is silent.
19:  *
20:  * Most logic lives in `hook-lib.mjs` so it is unit-testable without a
21:  * subprocess. This file is the thin stdin/stdout adapter.
22:  */
23: import { runHook, runStopHook, writeAuditLog, isStopEvent } from './hook-lib.mjs';
24: async function readStdin() {
25:   if (process.stdin.isTTY) return '';
26:   const chunks = [];
27:   for await (const chunk of process.stdin) chunks.push(chunk);
28:   return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf-8');
29: }
30: function stdinIsStop(stdinJson) {
31:   try {
32:     return isStopEvent(JSON.parse(stdinJson));
33:   } catch {
34:     // Malformed stdin falls through to runHook, which audits the skip.
35:     return false;
36:   }
37: }
38: async function main() {
39:   // Snapshot the inherited env FIRST so the re-entrancy guard checks the
40:   // parent's value, not the value we are about to export for any child
41:   // processes the hook might ever spawn.
42:   const inheritedEnv = { ...process.env };
43:   process.env.IMPECCABLE_HOOK_DEPTH = process.env.IMPECCABLE_HOOK_DEPTH || '1';
44:   let stdinJson = '';
45:   try { stdinJson = await readStdin(); } catch { /* fall through */ }
46:   const run = stdinIsStop(stdinJson) ? runStopHook : runHook;
47:   const result = await run({
48:     stdinJson,
49:     env: inheritedEnv,
50:     cwd: process.cwd(),
51:   });
52:   writeAuditLog(process.env, result.audit, process.cwd());
53:   if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(result.stdout);
54:   process.exit(result.exitCode || 0);
55: }
56: main().catch((err) => {
57:   // Last-ditch: never break the agent's turn even if something we did not
58:   // anticipate goes wrong. Audit-log the failure if logging is enabled.
59:   try {
60:     writeAuditLog(process.env, {
61:       ts: new Date().toISOString(),
62:       event: 'hook-error',
63:       error: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err),
64:     });
65:   } catch { /* swallow */ }
66:   if (process.env.IMPECCABLE_HOOK_DEBUG) {
67:     process.stderr.write(`[impeccable-hook] ${err}\n`);
68:   }
69:   process.exit(0);
70: });

 2621:         width: active ? '8px' : '6px',
 2622:         height: active ? '8px' : '6px',

 2640:     }

 2642:   }

 2739:   function toggleActionPicker() {

 2748:     });

 2797:   //
 2798:   // Params panel (per-variant coarse controls)
 2799:   //
 2800:   // Variants may declare a parameter manifest via a JSON attribute on the

 2802:   //

 2804:   //        data-impeccable-params='[{"id":"density","kind":"steps",...}]'>

 2827:   let paramsPanelPalette = null;

 2830:     const P = paramsPanelPalette;
 2831:     // Single element, always in the DOM. The slide animation is a CSS mask
 2832:     // with mask-size growing from 0% to 100% along the bar-facing axis - no
 2833:     // display toggle, no opacity toggle, no transform trickery. The mask
 2834:     // hides everything initially; as it grows, content is revealed from
 2835:     // the bar edge outward.
 2836:     paramsPanelEl = document.createElement('div');
 2837:     paramsPanelEl.id = PREFIX + '-params-panel';
 2838:     Object.assign(paramsPanelEl.style, {
 2839:       position: 'fixed', zIndex: String(Z.bar - 1),
 2840:       background: P.surfaceDeep,
 2841:       color: P.text,
 2842:       fontFamily: FONT,
 2843:       padding: '14px 18px',
 2844:       boxSizing: 'border-box',
 2845:       borderRadius: '0 0 10px 10px',
 2846:       pointerEvents: 'none',

 9748:   // Impeccable mark - same paths as site/components/Header.astro + favicon.svg.

 9755:   /**

 9759:   function agentHasWorkInFlight() {

 9761:   }
 9762:   /**
 9763:    * Derived at read time, not cached: which of the two reasons applies depends on

 9766:    * cached value while the wording stays current.
 9767:    */

 9771:   }
 9772:   function syncAgentPollingUi(connected) {

 9780:     // screen-reader users are left with the vaguer of the two readings.

 9783:       : 'Impeccable live mode');

 9789:       mark.style.opacity = '1';
 9790:     }

 9795:   function ensureAgentPollTooltip() {
 9796:     if (agentPollTooltipEl) return agentPollTooltipEl;
 9797:     const P = barPaletteForTheme(globalBarEl?.dataset.theme || detectPageTheme());
 9798:     agentPollTooltipEl = el('div', {
 9799:       position: 'fixed',
 9800:       display: 'none',
 9801:       opacity: '0',
 9802:       zIndex: String(Z.bar + 6),
 9803:       pointerEvents: 'none',
 9804:       maxWidth: '220px',
 9805:       padding: '6px 9px',

 9807:       background: P.chatSurface,

 9823:   function showAgentPollTooltip(anchor) {
 9824:     if (!agentStatusMessage || !anchor) return;
 9825:     const tip = ensureAgentPollTooltip();
 9826:     // Re-derive rather than reuse the cached copy: the live state may have moved
 9827:     // since the last status poll set it.
 9828:     tip.textContent = agentStatusText() || AGENT_DISCONNECTED_TIP;
 9829:     tip.style.transition = 'none';
 9830:     tip.style.display = 'block';
 9831:     tip.style.opacity = '1';
 9832:     const r = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
 9833:     const tipW = tip.offsetWidth;
 9834:     const tipH = tip.offsetHeight;
 9835:     const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - tipW - 8, r.left + r.width / 2 - tipW / 2));
 9836:     const top = Math.max(8, r.top - tipH - 8);
 9837:     tip.style.left = left + 'px';
 9838:     tip.style.top = top + 'px';
 9839:   }
 9840:   function hideAgentPollTooltip() {
 9841:     if (!agentPollTooltipEl) return;

 9851:   function fetchAgentPollingStatus() {

10568:       zIndex: String(Z.bar + 10),
10569:       pointerEvents: 'none',
10570:     });
10571:     designShadow = designHost.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
10572:     const style = document.createElement('style');
10573:     // Theme-match the bar: dark chrome on light pages, light chrome on dark pages.
10574:     const theme = detectPageTheme();
10575:     style.textContent = designPanelCss(barPaletteForTheme(theme));
10576:     designShadow.appendChild(style);
10577:     const root = document.createElement('div');
10578:     root.className = 'root';
10579:     designShadow.appendChild(root);
10580:     uiAppend(designHost);
10581:     // The host is pointer-events: none; the panel inside the shadow DOM
10582:     // manages its own auto/none. Events bubble through the shadow boundary,
10583:     // so attaching here silences host-page outside-interaction handlers
10584:     // without touching the host's click-through behavior.
10585:     defangOutsideHandlers(designHost, { setPointerEvents: false });
10586:     loadDesignPrefs();
10587:     renderDesignChrome();
10588:     if (designState.open) {
10589:       fetchDesignSystem();
10590:     }
10591:   }
10592:   // Neutral panel palette - deliberately NOT Impeccable-branded. The panel is
10593:   // a viewer of the project's design system, not an Impeccable surface.
10594:   const DP = {
10595:     canvas:   'oklch(94% 0 0)',            // panel background
10596:     tile:     'oklch(98.5% 0 0)',          // card-on-canvas
10597:     tileAlt:  'oklch(96% 0 0)',            // subtler tile for inner surfaces
10598:     ink:      'oklch(15% 0 0)',
10599:     ink2:     'oklch(35% 0 0)',
10600:     meta:     'oklch(55% 0 0)',
10601:     hairline: 'oklch(88% 0 0)',
10602:     hairlineSoft: 'oklch(92% 0 0)',
10603:     amber:    'oklch(77% 0.13 82)',         // stale-hint accent
10604:     amberBg:  'oklch(89% 0.055 84)',
10605:   };
10606:   function designPanelCss(BP) {
10607:     // BP = bar palette (theme-aware, matches the global bar).
10608:     // DP = internal content palette (neutral, so tiles render colors true).
10609:     return `
10610:       :host, .root { all: initial; }
10611:       .root {
10612:         font-family: ${FONT};
10613:         color: ${DP.ink};
10614:         pointer-events: none;
10615:       }
10616:       .root * { box-sizing: border-box; }
10617:       button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
10618:       /* Panel shell: chrome matches the bar; body canvas stays neutral */
10619:       .panel {
10620:         position: fixed; top: 12px; bottom: 72px; right: 12px;
10621:         width: ${DESIGN_PANEL_WIDTH}px; max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
10622:         background: ${BP.surface};
10623:         border: 1.5px solid ${BP.border};
10624:         border-radius: 14px;
10625:         box-shadow: ${BP.shadow};
10626:         display: flex; flex-direction: column;
10627:         transform: translateX(calc(100% + 24px));
10628:         opacity: 0;
10629:         transition: transform 0.35s ${EASE}, opacity 0.25s ${EASE};
10630:         pointer-events: none;
10631:         overflow: hidden;
10632:       }
10633:       .panel[data-open="true"] { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
10634:       .panel-header {
10635:         display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
10636:         padding: 10px 10px 10px 14px;
10637:         background: transparent;
10638:         border-bottom: 1px solid ${BP.hairline};
10639:       }
10640:       .panel-title {
10641:         flex: 1; min-width: 0;
10642:         font-family: ${MONO};
10643:         font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
10644:         letter-spacing: 0.02em;
10645:         color: ${BP.text};
10646:         white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
10647:       }
10648:       .panel-close {
10649:         border: none; background: transparent; color: ${BP.textDim};
10650:         width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 7px;
10651:         display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
10652:         cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
10653:       }
10654:       .panel-close:hover { background: ${BP.hairline}; color: ${BP.text}; }
10655:       .tabs {
10656:         display: inline-flex; padding: 2px;
10657:         background: ${BP.hairline};
10658:         border-radius: 7px;
10659:         gap: 2px;
10660:       }
10661:       .tab {
10662:         border: none; background: transparent;
10663:         padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 5px;
10664:         font-family: ${MONO};
10665:         font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
10666:         text-transform: uppercase;
10667:         color: ${BP.textDim}; cursor: pointer;
10668:         transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
10669:       }
10670:       .tab[data-active="true"] { background: ${BP.surface}; color: ${BP.text}; }
10671:       .panel-body {
10672:         flex: 1; overflow-y: auto;
10673:         padding: 12px 12px 20px;
10674:         background: ${DP.canvas};
10675:         scrollbar-width: thin;
10676:         scrollbar-color: ${DP.hairline} transparent;
10677:       }
10678:       .panel-body::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
10679:       .panel-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: ${DP.hairline}; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid transparent; background-clip: padding-box; }
10680:       /* States */
10681:       .empty, .loading, .error {
10682:         margin: 16px 4px;
10683:         padding: 28px 20px; text-align: center;
10684:         background: ${DP.tile}; border-radius: 14px;
10685:         color: ${DP.ink2}; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55;

10688:       .empty code { font-family: ${MONO}; background: ${DP.canvas}; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: ${DP.ink}; }
10689:       .error { color: oklch(58% 0.15 35); }

10699:       .stale-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${DP.amber}; flex-shrink: 0; }

10712:       .parsed-md-cta code { font-family: ${MONO}; background: ${DP.canvas}; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11.5px; color: ${DP.ink}; }

10746:       .t-tile { }
10747:       .t-specimen {
10748:         margin: 4px 0 6px;
10749:         color: ${DP.ink};
10750:         line-height: 0.9;
10751:       }

10753:       .t-purpose { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; color: ${DP.ink2}; }
10754:       /* Shadow tile */
10755:       .s-tile { }
10756:       .s-surface {
10757:         height: 60px; margin: 8px 2px 10px;

10759:         border-radius: 10px;

10761:       .s-value { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; color: ${DP.meta}; word-break: break-all; line-height: 1.4; }
10762:       .s-purpose { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: ${DP.ink2}; line-height: 1.45; }
10763:       /* Radii strip */
10764:       .r-strip { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
10765:       .r-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex: 1; min-width: 60px; }
10766:       .r-sample { width: 44px; height: 44px; background: ${DP.canvas}; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08); }
10767:       .r-label { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; color: ${DP.meta}; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }
10768:       .r-val { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; color: ${DP.ink}; }
10769:       /* Component tile (hosts live primitives) */
10770:       .cmp-tile { }
10771:       .cmp-stage {
10772:         margin: 12px -4px 0;
10773:         padding: 18px 16px 10px;
10774:         border-top: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft};
10775:         display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
10776:         gap: 14px;

10779:       .cmp-stage + .cmp-stage { border-top: 1px dashed ${DP.hairlineSoft}; }
10780:       .cmp-sublabel { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; color: ${DP.meta}; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
10781:       .cmp-kind { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: ${DP.meta}; }
10782:       /* Collapsible */
10783:       .coll {
10784:         margin: 0 4px 8px;
10785:         background: ${DP.tile};
10786:         border-radius: 12px;
10787:         overflow: hidden;
10788:       }
10789:       .coll-head {
10790:         display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
10791:         width: 100%;
10792:         padding: 12px 14px;
10793:         background: transparent; border: none;
10794:         cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
10795:         font-family: ${FONT}; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: ${DP.ink};
10796:         transition: background 0.12s ease;
10797:       }
10798:       .coll-head:hover { background: ${DP.tileAlt}; }
10799:       .coll-chev {
10800:         width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0;
10801:         color: ${DP.meta};

10805:       .coll-count { margin-left: auto; font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 10px; color: ${DP.meta}; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
10806:       .coll-body { padding: 0 14px 14px; display: none; }
10807:       .coll[data-open="true"] .coll-body { display: block; }
10808:       .rule-card {
10809:         padding: 10px 0;
10810:         border-top: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft};
10811:       }
10812:       .rule-card:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 2px; }
10813:       .rule-card .name { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: ${DP.ink}; margin-bottom: 3px; }
10814:       .rule-card .name .section { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: ${DP.meta}; margin-left: 8px; }
10815:       .rule-card .body { font-size: 11.5px; color: ${DP.ink2}; line-height: 1.5; }
10816:       .coll .dos { display: grid; gap: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
10817:       .coll .do, .coll .dont {
10818:         position: relative;
10819:         padding: 8px 0 8px 22px;
10820:         font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: ${DP.ink2};
10821:         border-top: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft};
10822:       }
10823:       .coll .do:first-child, .coll .dont:first-child,
10824:       .coll .do:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
10825:       .coll .do + .dont { border-top: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft}; }
10826:       .coll .do::before, .coll .dont::before {
10827:         content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 13px;
10828:         width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
10829:       }
10830:       .coll .do::before { background: oklch(45% 0.18 145); }
10831:       .coll .dont::before { background: oklch(58% 0.15 35); }
10832:       .coll .overview-body {
10833:         font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; color: ${DP.ink2};
10834:       }
10835:       .coll .overview-body .north-star {

10837:         font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; color: ${DP.ink};
10838:         margin-bottom: 8px;
10839:       }
10840:       .coll .overview-body p { margin: 0 0 8px; }
10841:       .coll .overview-body ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 16px; font-size: 11.5px; }
10842:       .coll .overview-body li { margin-bottom: 3px; }
10843:       /* raw tab markdown (unchanged layout, neutralized palette) */
10844:       .md { padding: 4px 10px 20px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: ${DP.ink}; }
10845:       .md h1, .md h2, .md h3, .md h4 { margin: 20px 0 8px; color: ${DP.ink}; font-weight: 600; }
10846:       .md h1 { font-size: 18px; }
10847:       .md h2 { font-size: 15px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft}; }
10848:       .md h3 { font-size: 13px; }
10849:       .md h4 { font-size: 12px; color: ${DP.meta}; }
10850:       .md p { margin: 0 0 10px; }

10852:       .md li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
10853:       .md code { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 12px; background: ${DP.canvas}; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; }
10854:       .md pre { font-family: ${MONO}; font-size: 12px; background: ${DP.canvas}; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0 0 10px; }
10855:       .md pre code { background: none; padding: 0; }
10856:       .md strong { font-weight: 700; }
10857:       .md em { font-style: italic; }
10858:       .md a { color: ${DP.ink}; text-decoration: underline; }
10859:       .md hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid ${DP.hairlineSoft}; margin: 16px 0; }
10860:     `;
10861:   }
10862:   function renderDesignChrome() {
10863:     const root = designShadow.querySelector('.root');
10864:     root.innerHTML = '';
10865:     // (Panel toggle lives in the global bar - no floating FAB.)
10866:     // Panel
10867:     const panel = document.createElement('aside');
10868:     panel.className = 'panel';
10869:     panel.setAttribute('data-open', designState.open ? 'true' : 'false');
10870:     panel.appendChild(buildDesignHeader());
10871:     const body = document.createElement('div');
10872:     body.className = 'panel-body';
10873:     body.id = 'panel-body';
10874:     panel.appendChild(body);
10875:     root.appendChild(panel);
10876:     renderDesignBody();
10877:   }
10878:   function buildDesignHeader() {
10879:     const header = document.createElement('div');
10880:     header.className = 'panel-header';
10881:     const title = document.createElement('div');
10882:     title.className = 'panel-title';
10883:     title.textContent = 'DESIGN.md';
10884:     header.appendChild(title);
10885:     const tabs = document.createElement('div');
10886:     tabs.className = 'tabs';
10887:     for (const t of [['visual', 'Visual'], ['raw', 'Raw']]) {
10888:       const btn = document.createElement('button');
10889:       btn.className = 'tab';
10890:       btn.textContent = t[1];
10891:       btn.setAttribute('data-active', designState.tab === t[0] ? 'true' : 'false');
10892:       btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
10893:         if (designState.tab === t[0]) return;
10894:         designState.tab = t[0];
10895:         saveDesignPrefs();
10896:         renderDesignChrome();
10897:         if (t[0] === 'raw' && designState.raw === null && !designState.loading) {
10898:           fetchDesignSystem(); // raw is part of the same fetch pair
10899:         }
10900:       });
10901:       tabs.appendChild(btn);
10902:     }
10903:     header.appendChild(tabs);
10904:     const close = document.createElement('button');
10905:     close.className = 'panel-close';
10906:     close.innerHTML = '&#x2715;';
10907:     close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close panel');
10908:     close.addEventListener('click', toggleDesignPanel);
10909:     header.appendChild(close);
10910:     return header;
10911:   }
10912:   function toggleDesignPanel() {
10913:     if (pendingApplyInFlight) { showManualApplyBusyToast(); return; }
10914:     designState.open = !designState.open;
10915:     renderDesignChrome();
10916:     updateGlobalBarState();
10917:     if (designState.open && designState.present === null && !designState.loading) {
10918:       fetchDesignSystem();
10919:     }
10920:   }
10921:   async function fetchDesignSystem() {
10922:     designState.loading = true;
10923:     designState.error = null;
10924:     renderDesignBody();
10925:     try {
10926:       const [jsonRes, rawRes] = await Promise.all([
10927:         fetch(`http://localhost:${PORT}/design-system.json?token=${TOKEN}`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
10928:         fetch(`http://localhost:${PORT}/design-system/raw?token=${TOKEN}`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
10929:       ]);
10930:       const jsonData = await jsonRes.json();
10931:       designState.present = jsonData.present === true;
10932:       designState.parsed = jsonData.parsed || null;
10933:       designState.sidecar = jsonData.sidecar || null;
10934:       designState.hasMd = !!jsonData.hasMd;
10935:       designState.hasSidecar = !!jsonData.hasSidecar;
10936:       designState.mdNewerThanJson = !!jsonData.mdNewerThanJson;
10937:       designState.raw = designState.present && rawRes.ok ? await rawRes.text() : null;
10938:       designState.error = jsonData.parseError || jsonData.sidecarError || null;
10939:     } catch (err) {
10940:       designState.error = err?.message || 'Failed to load design system.';
10941:     } finally {
10942:       designState.loading = false;
10943:       renderDesignChrome(); // refresh title from data
10944:     }
10945:   }
10946:   function renderDesignBody() {
10947:     const body = designShadow.querySelector('#panel-body');
10948:     if (!body) return;
10949:     body.innerHTML = '';
10950:     if (designState.loading) {
10951:       body.appendChild(msgDiv('loading', 'Loading design system…'));
10952:       return;
10953:     }
10954:     if (designState.error) {
10955:       body.appendChild(msgDiv('error', designState.error));
10956:       return;
10957:     }
10958:     if (designState.present === false) {
10959:       const empty = document.createElement('div');
10960:       empty.className = 'empty';
10961:       empty.innerHTML = `<strong>No DESIGN.md yet</strong>Create one by running <code>${IMPECCABLE_COMMAND} document</code> in your terminal, then re-open this panel.`;
10962:       body.appendChild(empty);
10963:       return;
10964:     }
10965:     if (designState.tab === 'raw') {
10966:       renderRawTab(body, designState.raw || '');
10967:       return;
10968:     }
10969:     // Visual tab - single unified render path.
10970:     if (designState.mdNewerThanJson) body.appendChild(renderStaleHint());
10971:     if (designState.hasMd && !designState.hasSidecar) {
10972:       body.appendChild(renderParsedMdCta());
10973:     }
10974:     renderDesignVisual(body, designState.parsed, designState.sidecar);
10975:   }
10976:   function msgDiv(cls, text) {
10977:     const d = document.createElement('div');
10978:     d.className = cls;
10979:     d.textContent = text;
10980:     return d;
10981:   }
10982:   function renderStaleHint() {
10983:     const box = document.createElement('div');
10984:     box.className = 'stale';
10985:     box.innerHTML = `
10986:       <span class="stale-dot"></span>
10987:       <span class="stale-text"><strong>DESIGN.md is newer than .impeccable/design.json.</strong> Run <code>${IMPECCABLE_COMMAND} document</code> to refresh the sidecar.</span>
10988:     `;
10989:     return box;
10990:   }
10991:   function renderParsedMdCta() {
10992:     const box = document.createElement('div');
10993:     box.className = 'parsed-md-cta';
10994:     box.innerHTML = `<strong>Basic view</strong>This panel reads the tokens in your <code>DESIGN.md</code> frontmatter. Running <code>${IMPECCABLE_COMMAND} document</code> also generates a <code>.impeccable/design.json</code> sidecar with your project's actual component snippets (button, input, nav) and tonal ramps, rendered live below the tokens.`;
10995:     return box;
10996:   }
10997:   // Unified render: merge parsed DESIGN.md frontmatter with sidecar v2
10998:   /**
10999:    * The empty state has to say which emptiness it is. `present:false` (no
11000:    * DESIGN.md at all) is handled upstream in renderDesignBody; everything here
11001:    * means the helper found a design system and this panel found nothing in it
11002:    * worth drawing. Telling that user "no design system data" reads as "your
11003:    * DESIGN.md is missing" and sends them to write a file they already have.
11004:    */
11005:   function designEmptyMessage() {
11006:     if (designState.hasMd && !designState.hasSidecar) {

 2: /**

 4:  */

13:   for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
14:     const arg = argv[i];
15:     if (arg === '--id') out.id = argv[++i];
16:     else if (arg.startsWith('--id=')) out.id = arg.slice('--id='.length);
17:     else if (arg === '--discarded' || arg === '--discard') out.status = 'discarded';
18:     else if (arg === '--error') { out.status = 'agent_error'; out.message = argv[++i] || 'unknown error'; }
19:     else if (arg.startsWith('--error=')) { out.status = 'agent_error'; out.message = arg.slice('--error='.length); }
20:     else if (arg === '--force') out.force = true;
21:     else if (arg === '--help' || arg === '-h') out.help = true;
22:   }
23:   return out;
24: }
25: export async function completeCli() {
26:   const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
27:   if (args.help || !args.id) {
28:     console.log(`Usage: node live-complete.mjs --id SESSION_ID [--discarded|--error MESSAGE] [--force]\n\nAppend the final durable session acknowledgement. Use after accept/discard cleanup is verified.\nCompletion is refused while the session's source file still carries live-mode leftovers\n(markers, data-p-* attributes, unbaked --p-* vars); fix the file or pass --force.`);
29:     process.exit(args.help ? 0 : 1);
30:   }
31:   // The carbonize contract used to be prose; this makes it mechanical. A
32:   // "complete" while the source still carries live plumbing is how markers
33:   // and dead param branches accumulated across sessions.
34:   if (args.status === 'complete' && !args.force) {
35:     const store = createLiveSessionStore({ cwd: process.cwd(), sessionId: args.id });
36:     const snapshot = store.getSnapshot(args.id, { includeCompleted: true });
37:     const sourceFile = snapshot?.sourceFile;
38:     const absSource = sourceFile ? path.resolve(process.cwd(), sourceFile) : null;
39:     const relSource = absSource ? path.relative(process.cwd(), absSource) : null;
40:     const insideProject = relSource !== null && relSource !== '' && !relSource.startsWith('..') && !path.isAbsolute(relSource);
41:     if (insideProject && !relSource.startsWith('node_modules' + path.sep) && !relSource.startsWith('node_modules/')) {
42:       const verify = verifyAcceptedFile(fs, absSource);
43:       if (!verify.clean) {
44:         console.log(JSON.stringify({
45:           ok: false,
46:           error: 'source_dirty',
47:           id: args.id,
48:           file: sourceFile,
49:           findings: verify.findings,
50:           hint: 'The accepted source still carries live-mode leftovers. Finish the carbonize cleanup (bake params, remove markers and data-p-* attributes), then run live-complete again. Use --force only if a finding is a false positive.',
51:         }, null, 2));
52:         process.exit(1);
53:       }
54:     }
55:   }

57:   const serverResult = serverInfo ? await completeThroughServer(serverInfo, args) : null;
58:   if (serverResult?.ok) {
59:     const store = createLiveSessionStore({ cwd: process.cwd(), sessionId: args.id });
60:     const snapshot = store.getSnapshot(args.id, { includeCompleted: true });
61:     console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, id: args.id, phase: snapshot?.phase || args.status, snapshot }, null, 2));
62:     return;
63:   }
64:   const store = createLiveSessionStore({ cwd: process.cwd(), sessionId: args.id });
65:   const event = args.status === 'discarded'

86:       body: JSON.stringify({ token: info.token, id: args.id, type, message: args.message }),

88:     if (!res.ok) return null;

29:   console.log('Usage: node live-discard-manual-edits.mjs [--page-url=<url>]');
30:   process.exit(0);

33: const cwd = process.cwd();
34: let discarded;
35: let entries;
36: const buffer = readBuffer(cwd);
37: if (pageUrlFilter) {
38:   entries = buffer.entries.filter((entry) => entry.pageUrl === pageUrlFilter);
39:   discarded = removeEntries(cwd, (entry) => entry.pageUrl === pageUrlFilter);
40: } else {
41:   entries = buffer.entries;
42:   discarded = truncateBuffer(cwd);
43: }
44: const remaining = readBuffer(cwd).entries.reduce((n, e) => n + e.ops.length, 0);
45: console.log(JSON.stringify({ discarded, entries, totalCount: remaining }));
