  1: // src/types/apiContracts.ts
  2: // Shared Interface Contracts for IRIS AI (Automatic Block Planning & Corridor Optimization)
  3: // 1. Core Enums & Literal Types
  4: export type DeploymentMode = 'ADVISORY' | 'AUTONOMOUS';
  5: export type DepartmentCode = 'TMS_CIVIL' | 'TDMS_ELECTRICAL' | 'SMMS_SIGNAL';
  6: export type UrgencyTier = 'P1_CRITICAL' | 'P2_SCHEDULED' | 'P3_ROUTINE';
  7: export type HorizonTier = 'TACTICAL_24H' | 'OPERATIONAL_7D' | 'STRATEGIC_30D';
  8: export type TrackCircuitId = 'TC-01' | 'TC-02' | 'TC-03' | 'TC-04' | 'TC-05' | 'TC-06';
  9: export type TrackLineCode = 'UP_SLOW' | 'DOWN_SLOW' | 'UP_FAST' | 'DOWN_FAST' | '5TH_LINE' | '6TH_LINE';
 10: export type DemandStatus = 'PENDING_TRIAGE' | 'TRIAGED' | 'SLOTTED' | 'SANCTIONED' | 'COMPLETED';
 11: export type BlockStatus = 'PROPOSED' | 'SANCTIONED' | 'ACTIVE' | 'RESTORED';
 12: export type CircuitOperationalStatus = 'CLEAR' | 'OCCUPIED' | 'MAINTENANCE_SLOTTED' | 'BLOCK_SANCTIONED' | 'POWER_ISOLATED';
 13: export type SignalAspect = 'RED' | 'YELLOW' | 'DOUBLE_YELLOW' | 'GREEN';
 14: export type TrainClassification = 'PREMIUM_PASSENGER' | 'EXPRESS' | 'SUBURBAN' | 'FREIGHT';
 15: // 2. Configurable Divisional Policy Profile
 16: export interface DivisionalPolicyProfile {
 17:   divisionId: string;
 18:   divisionName: string;
 19:   safetyHeadwayBufferMinutes: number; // Delta_clear (15 mins)
 20:   oheEarthingBufferMinutes: number;    // Delta_earth (10 mins)
 21:   oheRestorationBufferMinutes: number; // Delta_restore (10 mins)
 22:   defaultTsrSpeedKmh: number;          // 30 km/h
 23:   weightSafetyRisk: number;            // 0.40
 24:   weightDegradationRate: number;       // 0.35
 25:   weightTrafficDensity: number;        // 0.25
 26:   p1ScoreThreshold: number;            // 0.80
 27:   p2ScoreThreshold: number;            // 0.50
 28: }
 29: // 3. Maintenance Demand Contract
 30: export interface MaintenanceDemand {
 31:   demandId: string;
 32:   department: DepartmentCode;
 33:   trackCircuitId: TrackCircuitId;
 34:   trackLine: TrackLineCode;
 35:   stationSection: string;
 36:   chainageKm: number;
 37:   urgencyTier: UrgencyTier;
 38:   urgencyScore: number;
 39:   durationMinutes: number;
 40:   requiresPowerBlock: boolean;
 41:   assignedMachine?: string;
 42:   deadheadTransitMinutes: number;
 43:   status: DemandStatus;
 44:   rawTicketId: string;
 45:   defectDescription: string;
 46: }
 47: // 4. Joint Block Optimization Schedule
 48: export interface JointBlockSchedule {
 49:   blockId: string;
 50:   corridorName: string;
 51:   trackLine: TrackLineCode;
 52:   startTimeMinutes: number;  // 90 = 01:30 IST
 53:   endTimeMinutes: number;    // 285 = 04:45 IST
 54:   durationMinutes: number;   // 195 mins (rollover-safe)
 55:   affectedTrackCircuits: TrackCircuitId[];
 56:   bundledDemandIds: string[];
 57:   downtimeSavedMinutes: number;
 58:   corridorDowntimeSavedPct: number;
 59:   passengerDelaysMinutes: number; // 0 on nominal plans
 60:   kavachTsrSpeedKmh: number;
 61:   isEmergencyTsrFallback: boolean;
 62:   status: BlockStatus;
 63:   optimizationTimestamp: string;
 64: }
 65: // 5. Corridor KPI Metrics
 66: export interface CorridorKpiMetrics {
 67:   corridorDowntimeSavedPct: number;
 68:   assetAvailabilityIndexPct: number;
 69:   activeBlocksCount: number;
 70:   pendingDemandsCount: number;
 71:   whiteCorridorHeadwayMinutes: number;
 72:   activeKavachTsrsCount: number;
 73: }
 74: // 6. Track Circuit Interlocking State
 75: export interface TrackCircuitState {
 76:   circuitId: TrackCircuitId;
 77:   trackLine: TrackLineCode;
 78:   stationName: string;
 79:   kmStart: number;
 80:   kmEnd: number;
 81:   status: CircuitOperationalStatus;
 82:   activeBlockId?: string;
 83:   signalId: string;
 84:   signalAspect: SignalAspect;
 85:   isSignalClamped: boolean;

````markdown
  1: # IRIS AI (Intelligent Railway Inspection and Restoration AI)
  2: ### National-Grade Railway Safety, Interlocking Monitoring & Incident Intelligence Platform
  3: 
  4: [![Next.js 16](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16%20(App%20Router)-black?style=flat&logo=next.js)](https://nextjs.org/)
  5: [![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-blue?style=flat&logo=react)](https://react.dev/)
  6: [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.0-3178C6?style=flat&logo=typescript)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
  7: [![Tailwind CSS v4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-v4.0-38B2AC?style=flat&logo=tailwind-css)](https://tailwindcss.com/)

 11: ---
 12: 
 13: ## 📌 Executive Summary & Problem Statement
 14: 
 15: Indian Railways operates one of the world's most dense rail networks. Critical safety vulnerabilities such as **track obstruction (boulders, stray cattle, rail fractures)** and **platform foot-over-bridge (FOB) crowd surges** require sub-second detection and fail-safe deterministic intervention.
 16: 
 17: **IRIS AI (Intelligent Railway Inspection and Restoration AI)** bridges:
 18: 1. **Edge Computer Vision (YOLOv11 & Optical Flow)** for low-latency obstacle and crowd hazard detection.
 19: 2. **Deterministic RDSO-Standard Physics Engine (Kavach EBD)** calculating Emergency Braking Distances based on kinematic train dynamics.
 20: 3. **Station Section Dispatch & Platform Hold Engine** preventing stampedes and platform crowd surges.
 21: 4. **Explainable AI Compliance & Auditability Engine** producing tamper-evident SHA-256 digital seals and official RDSO Section 14B Compliance Dossiers.
 22: 
 23: ---
 24:

 96: 
 97: ## 📹 How the Cameras Work (Vision Pipeline Architecture)
 98: 
 99: IRIS AI ingests two synchronized optical edge streams:
100: 
101: ### A. Loco-Cab Forward Vision Camera (`LocoCameraFeed.tsx`)
102: - **Mount & Capture:** Windshield-mounted camera in locomotive cab #204 streaming 1080p @ 60fps covering up to $1,000\text{m}$ forward track section.
103: - **YOLOv11 Edge Inference ($\le 12\text{ ms}$):** Classifies hazards into `BOULDER`, `CATTLE`, and `RAIL_FRACTURE` with dynamic bounding boxes and confidence scores.
104: - **Depth / Range Mapping:** Accurately estimates obstacle distance $D_{\text{obstacle}}$ ($340\text{m}$, $680\text{m}$, $210\text{m}$).
105: - **HUD Live Telemetry Overlay:** Real-time speed ($V\text{ km/h}$), brake pressure ($P\text{ bar}$), distance, deceleration gauge, and solenoid state (`CLEAR` vs `EMERGENCY_SOLENOID_ACTUATED`).
106: 
107: ```mermaid
108: sequenceDiagram
109:     autonumber
110:     participant Cam as Loco-Cab Camera Feed
111:     participant Edge as YOLOv11 Edge Model
112:     participant Telem as Telemetry Aggregator
113:     participant RDSO as Kavach RDSO Physics
114:     participant Actuator as Braking Valve / Controller
115: 
116:     Cam->>Edge: Stream Frames (1080p @ 60fps)
117:     Edge->>Edge: Object Detection & Depth Mapping (12ms)
118:     Edge->>Telem: Hazard Detected (Class, Conf %, Dist m)
119:     Telem->>RDSO: Telemetry Vector (V=110km/h, μ=0.134, G=+0.002, t_react=1.96s)
120:     RDSO->>RDSO: Calculate Stopping Distance D_stop (15ms)
121:     alt Autonomous Mode
122:         RDSO->>Actuator: Actuate Emergency Solenoid (< 20ms)
123:     else Advisory Mode
124:         RDSO->>Actuator: Send Alert to Controller OP-402 (Waiting Approval)
125:     end
126: ```
127: 
128: ### B. Platform Gateway CCTV (`PlatformGatewayFeed.tsx`)
129: - **Mount & Location:** Wide-angle CCTV on Foot-Over-Bridge (FOB) Pillar #1 overlooking CSMT Platform 17/18 staircases.
130: - **YOLOv11 Headcount Estimation:** Continuously tallies passenger volume ($\text{PAX}$).
131: - **Lucas-Kanade Optical Flow:** Computes crowd velocity vector towards platform edges ($V_{\text{crowd}}\text{ m/s}$).
132: - **Occupancy Index ($\rho$):** Calculates density $\rho \in [0.0, 1.0]$. When $\rho > 0.80$, triggers an interlock hold on outer approach signal $S\text{-}16$ and starts a deterministic 5-minute evacuation countdown.
133: 
134: ---
135: 
136: ## ⚡ Multi-Agent Intelligence Core & RDSO Kavach Physics
137: 
138: ### 1. Kavach Emergency Braking Distance (EBD) Physics
139: The system enforces the strict RDSO kinematics braking equation:
140: 
141: $$D_{\text{stop}} = \frac{V^2}{2 \cdot g \cdot (\mu + G)} + (V \cdot t_{\text{reaction}})$$
142: 
143: Where:
144: - $V$: Train velocity in $\text{m/s}$ ($\frac{V_{\text{km/h}} \times 1000}{3600}$)
145: - $g$: Acceleration due to gravity ($9.81\text{ m/s}^2$)
146: - $\mu$: Rail-wheel friction coefficient (Standard steel rail = $0.134$)
147: - $G$: Track gradient ($+0.002$ uphill, $-0.002$ downhill)
148: - $t_{\text{reaction}}$: System reaction latency ($1.96\text{ seconds}$)
149: 
150: ### 2. Multi-Agent Latency Profile
151: - **Stage 1 (Vision Hazard Detector):** $12\text{ ms}$
152: - **Stage 2 (Telemetry Aggregator):** $24\text{ ms}$
153: - **Stage 3 (RDSO Physics Engine):** $15\text{ ms}$
154: - **Stage 4 (Actuation Gate):** $20\text{ ms}$ (Autonomous) / Controller Decision (Advisory)
155: - **Total Pipeline Execution Latency:** $\approx 51\text{ ms}$ (Edge Compute)
156:

196: ## 🛠️ How to Use the Software (Operator & Station Master Guide)
197: 
198: ### 🚀 Quick Start (Running Locally)
199: 
200: ```bash
201: # 1. Install dependencies
202: npm install
203: 
204: # 2. Run unit and integration tests (18 passing tests)
205: npm test
206: 
207: # 3. Start local development server
208: npm run dev
209: ```
210: 
211: Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.
212: 
213: ---
214: 
215: ### Step-by-Step Operator Guide
216: 
217: #### Step 1: Global Navigation & Mode Selection
218: - **Navbar Switcher:** Switch between **⚠️ ADVISORY (Phase 1)** (requires human-in-the-loop approval) and **⚡ AUTONOMOUS** (automatic sub-51ms brake actuation).
219: - **Tactical View Tabs:** Switch between View 1 (Overview), View 2 (Loco-Cab), and View 3 (Platform Gateway).
220: 
221: #### Step 2: View 1 — Overview & Track Interlocking
222: - **KPI Strip:** Review operational metrics (Active Trains, Track Circuits, Signals Active, Incidents Logged, Platform Holds, Telemetry Latency).
223: - **Interactive Interlocking Canvas:** Click signal lamps ($S\text{-}12$, $S\text{-}14$, $S\text{-}16$) to cycle aspects (`CLEAR` $\to$ `CAUTION` $\to$ `STOP`) and switch points ($\text{SW-04}$) to change route alignment (`NORMAL` $\to$ `REVERSE`).
224: - **Incident Triage Queue:** Filter alerts by severity (`CRITICAL`, `MODERATE`, `LOW`), inspect distance telemetry, and click `[APPROVE ACTION]` to authorize mitigations.
225: 
226: #### Step 3: View 2 — Loco-Cab Forward Vision
227: - **Select Scenario:** Test 3 distinct tactical scenarios:
228:   1. *Scenario 1:* 1.2m Boulder on Track 1A ($340\text{m}$, $110\text{ km/h}$).
229:   2. *Scenario 2:* Stray Cattle on Track 2 ($680\text{m}$, $110\text{ km/h}$).
230:   3. *Scenario 3:* Linear Rail Fracture on Curve Loop ($210\text{m}$, $90\text{ km/h}$).
231: - **Run Pipeline:** Click `[RUN 4-AGENT KAVACH PIPELINE]`.
232:   - In **Advisory Mode**, click `[APPROVE SOLENOID]` to authorize brake application.
233:   - In **Autonomous Mode**, watch immediate emergency solenoid actuation and deceleration to $0\text{ km/h}$.
234: 
235: #### Step 4: View 3 — Platform Gateway CCTV & Dispatch
236: - **Live Crowd Monitoring:** View live 1080p CCTV stream with YOLOv11 headcount and optical flow velocity vectors.
237: - **5-Minute Hold Countdown:** Outer signal $S\text{-}16$ holds approaching train #12137 (Punjab Mail) while Platform 17 staircase bottleneck is cleared.
238: - **Station Master Manual Overrides:**
239:   - `[RELEASE NOW]`: Immediately releases signal $S\text{-}16$.
240:   - `[EXTEND +3M]`: Adds 180 seconds to the hold timer.
241:   - `[RESET 5M]`: Resets countdown to the full 300-second interval.
242: 
243: #### Step 5: Compliance Auditing & Exporting Dossiers
244: - Click `[View 4-Step Explainable Decision Log Modal]`.
245: - Inspect the 4-step chronological audit trail and verify the **SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Seal** (`#9f8c4a1e7b2d...`).
246: - Click `[DOWNLOAD RDSO SECTION 14B COMPLIANCE DOSSIER]` to export a certified JSON compliance report.
247:

````markdown
  1: # SIH 26027: Domain Understanding & Operational Mechanics
  2: 
  3: > **Problem Statement ID:** 26027  
  4: > **Title:** AI-Powered Automatic Block Planning to Maximize Asset Availability for Train Operations on Indian Railways  
  5: > **Target System:** Auto-BDMS (Automated Block & Disconnection Management System) & Joint Multi-Department Corridor Optimizer  
  6: > **Governing Standards:** IRPWM 2020, ACTM Vol II, IRSEM 2021, G&SR Chapter 15, RDSO/SPN/196/2020 (Kavach Ver 4.0), and Google OR-Tools CP-SAT.
  7: 
  8: ---
  9: 
 10: ## 1. The Real-World Railway Operational Context
 11: 
 12: Indian Railways operates over 13,000 passenger trains and 8,000+ freight rakes daily over 68,000+ route kilometers. To keep this massive infrastructure safe, three independent technical departments maintain fixed assets:
 13: 
 14: 1. **Engineering Directorate (Civil / Permanent Way):**
 15:    * Rails, sleepers, ballast, turnouts, fishplates, bridges.
 16:    * Machine assets: Heavy track tampers (CSM, T-28), Dynamic Track Stabilizers (DTS), Ballast Cleaning Machines (BCM).
 17:    * Primary system: **Track Management System (TMS)**.
 18:    * Inspection & Standards: **IRPWM 2020 (Chapters 5 & 6)**; Ultrasonic Flaw Detection (**USFD**) logs classifying defects into **IMR** (*Immediate Removal* within 24h), **OBS** (*Observed*), and **REM** (*Removable* under speed restriction); Track Geometry Index (**TGI**) from Track Recording Cars (TRC).
 19: 
 20: 2. **Electrical / Traction Distribution (TRD) Directorate:**
 21:    * 25kV 50Hz AC Overhead Equipment (OHE), catenary and contact wires, pantograph wear, traction sub-stations (TSS), neutral sections.
 22:    * Maintenance vehicles: Self-propelled Tower Wagons (8-Wheeler/4-Wheeler).
 23:    * Primary system: **Traction Distribution Management System (TDMS)**.
 24:    * Inspection & Standards: **ACTM Vol II**; contact wire wear thresholds (< 74 mm² residual area), insulator washing in industrial zones, mandatory double-discharge earthing buffers ($\ge 10\text{ min}$).
 25: 
 26: 3. **Signal & Telecommunication (S&T) Directorate:**
 27:    * Electronic Interlocking (EI), point machines, track circuits (DC/AFTC), digital axle counters (SSDAC/MSDAC), signal aspects, Kavach RFID track balises.
 28:    * Primary system: **Signalling Maintenance & Management System (SMMS)**.
 29:    * Inspection & Standards: **IRSEM 2021 (Part II)**; point machine stroke times ($<4.5\text{s}$) & motor current ($1.5\text{--}2.5\text{A}$), relay drop voltages, and statutory **Form S&T/T-351** Disconnection Notices.
 30: 
 31: ---
 32: 
 33: ## 2. The Core Problem: Decentralized & Siloed Block Requisitions
 34: 
 35: Currently, each department requests track disconnections/traffic blocks independently through the **Block & Disconnection Management System (BDMS / e-BDMS)**:
 36: 
 37: * **Siloed Requests:** 
 38:   * Civil Engineering asks for 3 hours on Monday for track tamping on Block Section A-B.
 39:   * Electrical asks for 2.5 hours on Wednesday on the same Section A-B for OHE insulator washing.
 40:   * S&T asks for 2 hours on Friday on Section A-B for point machine overhauls.
 41: * **The Result:** The corridor is shut down **three separate times** in a single week, crippling throughput, delaying freight rakes, and frustrating passenger operations (accumulating 7.5 hours of disruption).
 42: * **Manual Section Controller Bottleneck:** The Section Controller in the Divisional Control Office uses **COA (Control Office Application)** to manually evaluate if a block can be sanctioned. Under pressure to keep trains moving, controllers often reject or curtail maintenance blocks, leading to deferred maintenance, asset failure risks, and emergency speed restrictions (TSRs).
 43: 
 44: ---
 45: 
 46: ## 3. The Solution: The Continuous 4-Step Operational Loop
 47: 
 48: To put it in exact railway operational terms, the **IRIS AI (Intelligent Railway Inspection and Restoration AI)** system executes four interconnected steps in a continuous automated loop:
 49: 
 50: ```mermaid
 51: graph TD
 52:     subgraph "Step 1: Multi-System Ingestion"
 53:         TMS["TMS (Civil P-Way)<br/>• USFD Defects (IMR/OBS/REM)<br/>• Track Recording Car (TRC) TGI<br/>• CSM / T-28 Tamper Machine Rosters"] 
 54:         TDMS["TDMS (Electrical TRD)<br/>• 25kV OHE Contact Wire Wear<br/>• Insulator Washing Schedules<br/>• Tower Wagon Vehicle Rosters"]
 55:         SMMS["SMMS (S&T)<br/>• Point Machine Stroke/Current<br/>• Electronic Interlocking Overhauls<br/>• Form S&T/T-351 Disconnections"]
 56:         COA["COA (Control Office)<br/>• Working Time Tables (WTT)<br/>• Live Train Running Delays<br/>• Goods Freight Path Forecasts"]
 57:     end
 58: 
 59:     TMS --> Normalizer["Unified Ingestion & Spatial Chainage Adapter<br/>(Linear Referencing & Track Circuit Converter)"]
 60:     TDMS --> Normalizer
 61:     SMMS --> Normalizer
 62:     COA --> Normalizer
 63: 
 64:     Normalizer --> Step2["Step 2: ML Urgency Triage & Priority Scoring<br/>(P1 Critical Flaws, P2 Periodic, P3 Preventive)"]
 65: 
 66:     Step2 --> Step3["Step 3: Joint Shadow-Block Optimizer Engine<br/>(Google OR-Tools CP-SAT Disjunctive Solver)"]
 67: 
 68:     Step3 --> Output["Optimized Block Plan<br/>(Bundled Multi-Department Windows)"]
 69: 
 70:     Output --> Step4["Step 4: Safety & Sanction Dispatch Gate<br/>• Form S&T/T-351 Interlocking Lockout<br/>• Form T/409 Caution Order Broadcast<br/>• Direct Kavach TCAS Wireless TSR Injection"]
 71: ```
 72: 
 73: ### 1. Multi-System Ingestion:
 74: Continuously aggregates defect logs, overdue schedules, and asset health alerts across:
 75: * **TMS:** P1/P2/P3 track defects, rail fracture alerts, ultrasonic flaw detection (USFD) logs per IRPWM 2020, Track Geometry Index (TGI) from Track Recording Cars.
 76: * **TDMS:** Catenary/contact wire wear, neutral section inspections, 25kV power shut-off requisitions per ACTM Vol II.
 77: * **SMMS:** Point machine overhaul cycles, track circuit fail-safe status, signal aspect inspections, Form S&T/T-351 disconnections per IRSEM 2021.
 78: * **COA:** Real-time train positions, scheduled timetables, and goods freight path forecasts.
 79: 
 80: ### 2. ML Urgency Triage & Scoring:
 81: Quantifies the criticality of every maintenance demand:
 82: $$\text{Urgency Score} = w_1 \cdot \text{SafetyRisk} + w_2 \cdot \text{AssetDegradationRate} \cdot \Delta t + w_3 \cdot \frac{\text{OverdueDays}}{\text{TargetCycleDays}}$$
 83: Classifies demands into:
 84: * **P1 (Immediate Safety Risk / Score 80–100):** Rail fractures (IMR), acute catenary sag, track circuit drop $\to$ Slotted into immediate 24h nocturnal lull or emergency speed cap.
 85: * **P2 (Scheduled Periodicity Bound / Score 50–79):** Track tamping cycles, point machine motor overhauls $\to$ Bundled into 7-day rolling corridor.
 86: * **P3 (Preventive / Deferrable / Score 0–49):** Drain clearing, insulator washing, ballast dressing $\to$ Scheduled in 30-day cyclical maintenance window.
 87: 
 88: ### 3. Joint Shadow-Block Optimizer (The Core Innovation):
 89: Instead of scheduling separate blocks, the engine **co-locates and bundles** demands via Google OR-Tools CP-SAT disjunctive scheduling:
 90: * **Co-Location Clustering:** When an OHE power block is required on Section KM 102–115, the system automatically checks TMS and SMMS for pending tasks on the same chainage.
 91: * **Shadow Blocking:** Civil track gangs and S&T technicians work simultaneously underneath the de-energized OHE window ($\Delta_{\text{earth}} \ge 10\text{ min}$, $\Delta_{\text{restore}} \ge 10\text{ min}$), performing three days of maintenance in a single 3.5-hour slot.
 92: * **Corridor Headway Matching:** Analyzes COA timetables to schedule blocks inside natural off-peak traffic lulls (e.g., 01:30 AM to 05:00 AM) or creates planned freight diversions with a mandatory $15\text{ minute}$ passenger clearance buffer ($\Delta_{\text{clear}}$).
 93: 
 94: ### 4. Safety Integration & Kavach Dissemination:
 95: When the Section Controller clicks `[SANCTION BLOCK]`:
 96: * **Kavach TCAS Dissemination (`RDSO/SPN/196/2020`):** Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSR $30\text{ km/h}$) and track closure limits are broadcast wirelessly via the Temporary Speed Restriction Management System (TSRMS) directly to locomotive cab units and stationary RFID balises.
 97: * **Interlocking Lockout (Form S&T/T-351):** The electronic interlocking (EI) on the section is safely clamped to prevent conflicting signal aspects.
 98: * **Caution Order Generation (Form T/409):** Automated digital caution orders are generated for train operating crew.
 99: * **Auditor Compliance Dossier:** Generates an immutable 4-step explainable record signed with SHA-256 cryptographic hash complying with RDSO Chapter 15 and General & Subsidiary Rules (G&SR).
100: 
101: ---
102: 
103: ## 4. Multi-Horizon Block Planning via Rolling Horizon Framework
104: 
105: Instead of relying on static, fragile long-term schedules or myopic day-to-day decisions, IRIS AI uses a **Rolling Horizon Framework (RHF)** to solve multi-horizon block planning. The engine optimizes over a forward-looking prediction window ($H$), locks in immediate actions during an execution window ($\Delta t$), and continuously rolls forward as live telemetry updates.
106: 
107: | Horizon | Scope ($H$) | Step / Freeze ($\Delta t$) | Primary Objective & Assets | Mathematical & Regulatory Driver |
108: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
109: | **Horizon 1: Tactical Horizon** | 24 Hours | 1 Hour | Night-lull slot allocation ($01:30\text{--}04:30\text{ AM}$), emergency P1 USFD IMR flaw insertion, real-time COA delay conflict resolution, dynamic Kavach TSR broadcast. | Shortest-Path Conflict Resolution, Headway buffer $\ge 15\text{ min}$, RDSO/SPN/196/2020 TSRMS. |
110: | **Horizon 2: Operational Horizon** | 7 Days | 24 Hours | Multi-department shadow block bundling (Civil track tamping, TRD 25kV OHE power shutdowns, S&T point machine overhauls), machine gang rosters, freight path diversion windows. | Google OR-Tools CP-SAT Disjunctive Interval Scheduling, CRIS RBS (Rolling Block System). |
111: | **Horizon 3: Strategic Horizon** | 26 Weeks | 1 Week | Master corridor block programmes, long-range Track Geometry Index (TGI) degradation tracking, heavy machine fleet routing (CSM tampers, BCM ballast cleaners), seasonal monsoon/fog prep. | Stochastic rail degradation $\delta_i(\tau) = \delta_i(\tau_k)e^{\alpha_i\tau} + \epsilon$, Indian Railways GR 15.02, Operating Manual Ch 22. |
112: 
113: ### How the Rolling Mechanism Operates
114: 1. **Solve:** At time $t$, solve the CP-SAT optimization model over horizon $[t, t+H]$.
115: 2. **Execute:** Commit and execute only the decisions within $[t, t+\Delta t]$.
116: 3. **Roll & Ingest:** Advance time to $t+\Delta t$. Ingest real-time feedback (actual job completion logs, new USFD defects from TMS, train delays from COA).
117: 4. **Re-Optimize:** Re-solve over $[t+\Delta t, t+\Delta t+H]$, preserving long-term corridor capacity without breaking the live railway network.
118: 
119: ---
120: 
121: ## 5. Measured Operational Impact
122: 
123: * **Corridor Downtime Reduction:** **35% to 50% reduction** in total line block hours via automated multi-department shadow blocking.
124: * **Asset Availability Increase:** **+18% increase** in available corridor paths for freight and passenger operations.
125: * **Punctuality Impact:** Zero scheduled passenger cancellations and < 1.2% secondary delay propagation.
126: * **Safety & Compliance:** 100% digital compliance with RDSO safety rules, Form S&T/T-351 electronic interlocks, and zero field gang collisions.
````

 79: 
 80: ---
 81: 
 82: ## 🔍 2. Detailed Elaboration of Core Solver Use Cases
 83: 
 84: ### UC-01: Ingest & Normalize Asset Demands
 85: * **Primary Actors:** Departmental Planners (P-Way, TRD, S&T), CRIS Systems (TMS, TDMS, SMMS).
 86: * **Trigger:** Daily/hourly synchronization from CRIS databases.
 87: * **Description:** Ingests unstructured defect logs, overdue maintenance work orders, ultrasonic flaw detection (USFD) records (IMR/OBS/REM per IRPWM 2020), contact wire wear (< 74 mm² per ACTM), and Track Geometry Index (TGI) deficits. Normalizes engineering chainage markers (e.g., `KM 108/4 to 112/2`) into discrete electrical track circuit nodes (`TC-01` to `TC-06`).
 88: * **Output:** Normalized stream of `MaintenanceDemandRecord` objects ready for solver indexing.
 89: 
 90: ---
 91: 
 92: ### UC-02: Triage Demand Urgency & Safety Score
 93: * **Primary Actor:** ML Urgency Triage Classifier.
 94: * **Precondition:** Ingestion and normalization complete.
 95: * **Formulation:** Evaluates urgency score $S_i \in [0, 1]$:
 96:   $$S_i = 0.45 \cdot \text{SafetyRisk} + 0.35 \cdot \text{DegradationRate} \cdot \Delta t + 0.20 \cdot \frac{\text{OverdueDays}}{\text{TargetCycleDays}}$$
 97: * **Tier Categorization:**
 98:   * **P1 (Immediate Threat / Score 80–100):** Transverse rail fractures (IMR), sudden OHE sagging, track circuit fail-safes. Slated into **24-Hour Tactical Horizon**.
 99:   * **P2 (Scheduled Maintenance / Score 50–79):** Track tamping cycles, point machine motor overhauls. Slated into **7-Day Operational Matrix**.
100:   * **P3 (Preventive / Routine / Score 0–49):** Drain cleaning, ballast dressing, insulator washing. Scheduled during opportunistic shadow blocks.
101: 
102: ---
103: 
104: ### UC-03: Analyze COA Headways & Traffic Gaps
105: * **Primary Actor:** CRIS COA (Control Office Application).
106: * **Description:** Reads dynamic train charts, passenger express schedules, suburban EMU frequencies, and goods freight forecasts. Calculates natural time-distance headways ($\ge 15\text{ min}$) and isolates white-corridor windows (predominantly 01:30 to 04:30 AM nocturnal lulls).
107: 
108: ---
109: 
110: ### UC-04: Execute CP-SAT / MILP Corridor Optimization (The Solver Core)
111: * **Mathematical Solver:** Google OR-Tools (`ortools.sat.python.cp_model.CpModel`) disjunctive interval scheduling.
112: * **Objective Function:**
113:   $$\min \quad \alpha \sum_{b \in \mathcal{B}} \text{Duration}(b) + \beta \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \Delta_{t}^{\text{delay}} + \gamma \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D}_{\text{deferred}}} \text{Risk}(d) - \delta \sum_{d_1, d_2 \in \text{Bundled}} \text{Synergy}(d_1, d_2)$$
114: * **Sub-Use Cases & Constraints:**
115:   * **UC-04.1 (Minimize Corridor Downtime):** Minimizes total minutes track sections $s$ are blocked from active train movements.
116:   * **UC-04.2 (Zero-Passenger Cancellation & 15m Buffer):** Hard constraint: zero passenger cancellations and $t_{\text{start}}(t_{\text{passenger}}) - t_{\text{end}}(b) \ge 15\text{ min}$ safety clearance margin ($\Delta_{\text{clear}}$).
117:   * **UC-04.3 (Co-Located Shadow Blocking):** Civil track gangs and S&T technicians work simultaneously underneath de-energized OHE windows ($\Delta_{\text{earth}} \ge 10\text{ min}$, $\Delta_{\text{restore}} \ge 10\text{ min}$), eliminating 35%–50% of redundant line closures.
118:   * **UC-04.4 (Resource Feasibility):** Enforces availability limits for high-capacity machines (CSM tampers, BCM ballast cleaners, Tower Wagons) and field maintenance gangs.
119: 
120: ---
121: 
122: ### UC-05: Generate Multi-Horizon Schedules (Rolling Horizon Framework)
123: * **Primary Actor:** Rolling Horizon Multi-Horizon Schedule Generator.
124: * **Description:** Operates a rolling horizon framework ($H$ prediction window, $\Delta t$ control execution step) to decompose large-scale network block planning into three synchronized tiers:
125:   1. **UC-05.1 (Daily Tactical - 24 Hours, $\Delta t = 1\text{h}$):** Real-time conflict resolution, night-lull slotting ($01:30\text{--}04:30\text{ AM}$), and emergency P1 USFD IMR flaw insertion with Kavach TSR broadcast.
126:   2. **UC-05.2 (Weekly Operational - 7 Days, $\Delta t = 24\text{h}$):** Rolling corridor schedule bundling civil, electrical, and signal teams into coordinated 3.5-hour joint shadow blocks across divisional sections per CRIS RBS.
127:   3. **UC-05.3 (Strategic RBP - 26 Weeks, $\Delta t = 1\text{w}$):** Rolling Block Programme per Indian Railways GR 15.02, cyclic corridor overhauls, machine depot logistics (CSM, BCM), and Track Geometry Index (TGI) recovery projections.
128: 
129: ---
130: 
131: ### UC-06: Simulate 'What-If' Disruption Scenarios
132: * **Primary Actor:** Divisional Section Controller.
133: * **Trigger:** Controller inputs simulated weather disruptions (e.g., monsoon flooding $\mu=0.095$, winter fog) or emergency freight priority diversions.
134: * **Outcome:** The solver re-runs in $<15\text{ seconds}$, dynamically shifting block windows and projecting alternative corridor paths.
135: 
136: ---
137: 
138: ### UC-07: Sanction & Dispatch Corridor Block (Auto-BDMS Sanction Gate)
139: * **Primary Actor:** Divisional Section Controller (`Sr. DOM`).
140: * **Trigger:** Controller reviews proposed bundled block on the **Corridor Time-Distance String Chart** and clicks `[SANCTION BLOCK]`.
141: * **Outcome:** The system issues digital sanction tokens to station masters, generates **Form T/409 Caution Orders**, updates the e-BDMS portal, and triggers UC-08 and UC-09.
142: 
143: ---
144: 
145: ### UC-08: Broadcast Kavach TSR & Form S&T/T-351 Lockout
146: * **Primary Secondary Actors:** Kavach TCAS locomotive units (`RDSO/SPN/196/2020`), Electronic Interlocking (EI).
147: * **Description:** 
148:   * Automatically transmits **Temporary Speed Restriction (TSR 30 km/h)** packets wirelessly via the Temporary Speed Restriction Management System (TSRMS) and trackside radio balises to all locomotive cabs operating in the zone.
149:   * Enforces statutory **Form S&T/T-351** electronic interlocking lockout by clamping signal aspects (`S-12`, `S-14`) to danger (`RED`) in relay logic to physically protect track gangs.
150: 
151: ---
152: 
153: ### UC-09: Compile Explainable Decision Dossier
154: * **Primary Actor:** Safety Compliance Auditor / RDSO Inspector.
155: * **Description:** Compiles an immutable 4-step explainable record signed with a SHA-256 cryptographic hash:
156:   1. *Ingestion Evidence:* Specific TMS, SMMS, TDMS ticket IDs and chainage markers.
157:   2. *Conflict Resolution:* Avoided train path bottlenecks.
158:   3. *Co-Location Savings:* Exact hours saved by bundling OHE with tamping.
159:   4. *Safety Confirmation:* Verified Kavach TSR dissemination, Form S&T/T-351 electronic lockout, and Form T/409 Caution Order emission.
160: * **Export:** One-click download of official **RDSO Form 14B Safety Compliance Certificate**.
````

## File: docs/mock_data_resources.md
````markdown
  1: # IRIS AI — Mock Data & Corridor Simulation Resources (SIH 26027)
  2: 
  3: > **Location:** `docs/mock_data_resources.md`  
  4: > **Problem Statement:** SIH 26027 — *"AI-Powered Automatic Block Planning to Maximize Asset Availability for Train Operations on Indian Railways"*  
  5: > **Target Dataset:** TMS (Civil P-Way), SMMS (S&T), TDMS (Electrical TRD), COA Timetables & Joint Block Bundles  
  6: > **Standards Grounding:** IRPWM 2020, ACTM Vol II, IRSEM 2021, G&SR Chapter 15, RDSO/SPN/196/2020 (Kavach Ver 4.0)
  7: 
  8: ---
  9: 
 10: ## 🚀 1. Ready-to-Use Local Mock Dataset (`src/lib/mockData.ts`)
 11: 
 12: `src/lib/mockData.ts` provides zero-dependency, fully-typed TypeScript datasets for corridor block planning. Components and API routes can import these immediately:
 13: 
 14: ```typescript
 15: import {
 16:   MOCK_TMS_DEMANDS,       // Civil P-Way flaws, USFD IMR/OBS/REM alerts, TGI scores
 17:   MOCK_SMMS_DEMANDS,      // Signal & Telecom point machines, Form S&T/T-351 requests
 18:   MOCK_TDMS_DEMANDS,      // Electrical TRD 25kV OHE power blocks & wear logs
 19:   MOCK_COA_TRAIN_PATHS,   // Express & Freight train time-distance slots
 20:   MOCK_JOINT_BLOCK_PLANS, // Bundled shadow-block windows with downtime savings
 21:   MOCK_CORRIDOR_KPIS,     // 38.4% downtime saved, 96.2% asset availability
 22:   MOCK_KAVACH_TSR_STREAM  // Active 30 km/h temporary speed restrictions (TSRMS)
 23: } from '@/lib/mockData';
 24: ```
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: ## 🚂 2. Indian Railways Corridor Benchmark Profiles
 29: 
 30: The mock datasets simulate realistic high-density trunk routes:
 31: 
 32: ### Profile A: Central Railway — CSMT to Kalyan Corridor (Mumbai Division)
 33: * **Route Length:** 54.0 km (Quadruple Track — Up/Down Fast & Slow).
 34: * **Daily Trains:** Over 850 suburban EMUs, 120 long-distance mail/express, and 35 goods freight rakes.
 35: * **Maintenance Window:** Tight 3-hour nocturnal white corridor (01:30 to 04:30 IST).
 36: * **Track Circuits Simulated:** `TC-01` (CSMT) $\to$ `TC-02` (Byculla) $\to$ `TC-03` (Dadar) $\to$ `TC-04` (Kurla) $\to$ `TC-05` (Thane) $\to$ `TC-06` (Kalyan).
 37: 
 38: ### Profile B: Eastern Railway — Howrah to Bardhaman Main Line
 39: * **Route Length:** 107.0 km (Triple/Quadruple line with heavy coal freight paths).
 40: * **High-Capacity Assets:** CSM Tamping Machines (Plasser India), 8-Wheeler Tower Wagons for OHE 25kV inspection.
 41: 
 42: ---
 43: 
 44: ## 📊 3. Sample Grounded Mock Records
 45: 
 46: ### 3.1 Civil Track Demand (TMS — IRPWM 2020 Compliance)
 47: ```typescript
 48: {
 49:   id: "TMS-2026-804",
 50:   department: "TMS_CIVIL",
 51:   assetType: "RAIL_TRACK",
 52:   sectionId: "CSMT-KYN-UP",
 53:   chainageKm: "KM 108/4 - 112/2",
 54:   trackCircuitId: "TC-03",
 55:   urgencyTier: "P1_CRITICAL",
 56:   urgencyScore: 0.94,

## File: docs/prd.md
````markdown
  1: # IRIS AI — Product Requirements Document (PRD)
  2: 
  3: **Project Name:** IRIS AI (Intelligent Railway Inspection and Restoration AI): Automated Block Planning & Corridor Optimization System (Auto-BDMS)  
  4: **SIH Problem Statement:** 26027 — *"AI-Powered Automatic Block Planning to Maximize Asset Availability for Train Operations on Indian Railways"*  
  5: **Document Version:** 3.1.0 (Grounded Multi-Horizon Core & Fully Decoupled Policy Specification)  
  6: **Target Platform:** National Railway Corridor Operations & Divisional Control Centers  
  7: **Governing Standards & Foundation:** Multi-Horizon Rolling Planning Framework (CP-SAT Interval Scheduling), IRPWM 2020, ACTM Vol II, IRSEM 2021, G&SR Chapter 15, RDSO/SPN/196/2020 (Kavach Ver 4.0)  
  8: **Target Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, FastAPI / Python CP-SAT Solver (Google OR-Tools)
  9: 
 10: > **Architectural Decoupling Notice:**  
 11: > All numerical metrics (e.g. 38.4% downtime reduction, 96.2% availability index), urgency weights ($w_1, w_2, w_3$), safety headway buffers ($\Delta t_{\text{headway}}$), earthing durations ($\Delta_{\text{earth}}$), and TSR speeds are parameterized via dynamic `DivisionalPolicyProfile` configurations and Hexagonal `IIngestionAdapter` interfaces. The verified mathematical core is the Multi-Horizon Rolling Horizon framework.
 12: 
 13: ---
 14: 
 15: ## 1. Executive Summary & Problem Understanding
 16: 
 17: ### 1.1 The Challenge in Indian Railways Today
 18: Indian Railways fixed railway infrastructure (track permanent way, 25kV traction distribution, signaling & telecommunication) is maintained by three separate engineering directorates:
 19: * **Civil / P-Way Engineering (Track Management System - TMS):** Governed by *IRPWM 2020*.
 20: * **Electrical / TRD (Traction Distribution Management System - TDMS):** Governed by *ACTM Vol II*.
 21: * **Signal & Telecom / S&T (Signalling Maintenance & Management System - SMMS):** Governed by *IRSEM 2021*.
 22: 
 23: Currently, each department requests line disconnections independently through the **Block & Disconnection Management System (BDMS / e-BDMS)**. This process is decentralized, uncoordinated, and manual:
 24: 1. **Departmental Silos & Disconnected Maintenance:** A section of track is often blocked 3 separate times in a single week for civil, electrical, and signal work, multiplying corridor downtime (up to 7.5+ hours of weekly disruption per section).
 25: 2. **Controller Cognitive Overload:** Section Controllers in Divisional Control Offices manage traffic via the **Control Office Application (COA)**. They lack automated decision-support tools to identify traffic gaps, evaluate network impact, or co-schedule multiple maintenance tasks.
 26: 3. **Severe Asset Downtime & Throughput Loss:** Suboptimal block allocation results in cancelled freight paths, passenger punctuality loss, or deferred maintenance leading to emergency Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSRs).
 27: 
 28: ### 1.2 The Solution Vision: Auto-BDMS
 29: **IRIS AI** is an AI-driven, constraint-optimized Automatic Block Planning System that:
 30: * Ingests and normalizes maintenance requests across TMS, SMMS, TDMS, and train paths from COA.
 31: * Clusters co-located demands into **Automated Multi-Department Joint Shadow Blocks** (Civil + S&T working underneath de-energized OHE windows).
 32: * Solves corridor time-distance scheduling using Google OR-Tools CP-SAT disjunctive interval scheduling to minimize downtime and eliminate passenger delays.
 33: * Operates across **Multi-Horizon Planning** (24h Tactical, 7-Day Operational, 30-Day Strategic).
 34: * Protects field crews by disseminating digital Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSR) via the **Kavach TCAS TSRMS** directly to locomotive cab units, issuing statutory **Form S&T/T-351** interlocking lockouts and **Form T/409** Caution Orders upon block sanction.
 35: 
 36: ---
 37: 
 38: ## 2. User Personas & Roles
 39: 
 40: | Persona | Role & Platform Access | Key Needs & Behaviors |
 41: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
 42: | **Divisional Section Controller (Sr. DOM / Section Dispatcher)** | Command Center Dashboard & Corridor String Chart | Evaluates corridor capacity, reviews AI-optimized joint block recommendations, and executes one-click block sanctions (`[SANCTION BLOCK]`). |
 43: | **Departmental Maintenance Planners (P-Way, TRD, S&T)** | Department Demand Queue & Machine Planning View | Enters and tracks maintenance work orders (TMS/TDMS/SMMS), reviews joint bundling proposals, and coordinates machine (CSM, BCM, Tower Wagon) and manpower gang deployment. |
 44: | **Safety Compliance Auditor / RDSO Inspector** | Auditor Workspace & Decision Dossier | Audits immutable 4-step AI scheduling logs (Ingestion $\to$ Conflict Check $\to$ Shadow Bundling $\to$ Sanction & Safety TSR) and exports RDSO Form 14B compliance certificates. |
 45: | **Locomotive Pilot & Field Station Master** | Cab Display & Station Control Console | Receives automated Kavach Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSR), Form S&T/T-351 signal lockout alerts, and digital Form T/409 Caution Orders for active maintenance sections. |
 46: 
 47: ---
 48: 
 49: ## 3. System Architecture & Core Functional Modules
 50: 
 51: ```mermaid
 52: graph TD
 53:     subgraph "1. Multi-Source Ingestion"
 54:         TMS["TMS (USFD IMR/OBS/REM, TGI, Tamping)"] --> Ingest["Unified Ingestion & Spatial Adapter"]
 55:         SMMS["SMMS (Signals, Points, Form S&T/T-351)"] --> Ingest
 56:         TDMS["TDMS (25kV OHE Catenary, Power Cuts)"] --> Ingest
 57:         COA["COA (Train Timetables & Freight Forecasts)"] --> Ingest
 58:     end
 59: 
 60:     subgraph "2. Core Optimization Engine"
 61:         Ingest --> Triage["ML Urgency Triage (P1 / P2 / P3)"]
 62:         Triage --> Solver["Google OR-Tools CP-SAT Disjunctive Solver"]
 63:         Solver --> Bundler["Multi-Department Joint Shadow Bundler"]
 64:     end
 65: 
 66:     subgraph "3. Operator Cockpit & UI Surfaces"
 67:         Bundler --> Gantt["Corridor Time-Distance String Chart"]
 68:         Bundler --> Queue["Department Demand Triage Queue"]
 69:         Bundler --> Switcher["Multi-Horizon Switcher (24h / 7D / 30D)"]
 70:         Bundler --> Interlocking["Track Interlocking & Circuit Map"]
 71:     end
 72: 
 73:     subgraph "4. Safety & Compliance Dispatch"
 74:         Gantt --> Sanction{"Controller Sanction Gate"}
 75:         Sanction -->|Approved| Kavach["Kavach TSRMS & Radio Balise Broadcast"]
 76:         Sanction -->|Approved| InterlockLock["Form S&T/T-351 Electronic Lockout"]
 77:         Sanction -->|Approved| CautionOrder["Form T/409 Caution Order Generation"]
 78:         Sanction -->|Approved| Dossier["4-Step Explainable Decision Dossier (SHA-256)"]
 79:     end
 80: ```
 81: 
 82: ---
 83: 
 84: ## 4. Detailed Functional Requirements
 85: 
 86: ### 4.1 Module 1: Multi-System Data Ingestion & Spatial Normalization
 87: * **TMS Ingestion (IRPWM 2020):** Ingests rail flaw alerts, ultrasonic flaw detection (USFD) records (IMR/OBS/REM), track tamping requirements, and Track Geometry Index (TGI) deficit sections based on standard deviation formula:
 88:   $$\text{TGI} = \frac{2U_I + T_I + 6A_I + G_I}{10}$$
 89: * **TDMS Ingestion (ACTM Vol II):** Ingests 25kV OHE catenary/contact wire wear logs (< 74 mm²), neutral section overhaul schedules, insulator wash demands, and power block requests with mandatory $\ge 10\text{ min}$ discharge earthing buffers ($\Delta_{\text{earth}}$, $\Delta_{\text{restore}}$).
 90: * **SMMS Ingestion (IRSEM 2021):** Ingests point machine operating stroke times ($<4.5\text{s}$) & current ($1.5\text{--}2.5\text{A}$), track circuit relay health, electronic interlocking maintenance logs, and statutory **Form S&T/T-351** disconnection demands.
 91: * **COA Ingestion:** Real-time train tracking, scheduled passenger timetables, dynamic running delays, and goods freight rake path forecasts.
 92: * **Spatial Chainage Normalizer:** Converts railway kilometer markers (e.g. `KM 108/4 - 114/2`) into discrete track circuit identifiers (`TC-01` through `TC-06`).
 93: 
 94: ### 4.2 Module 2: ML Urgency Triage & Priority Scoring
 95: * Calculates a dynamic urgency score for every maintenance requisition:
 96:   $$\text{Priority Score} = w_1 \cdot \text{SafetyCriticality} + w_2 \cdot \text{DegradationRate} \cdot \Delta t + w_3 \cdot \frac{\text{OverdueDays}}{\text{TargetCycleDays}}$$
 97: * Categorizes tasks into:
 98:   * **P1 (Immediate / Safety Threat / Score 80–100):** Slotted into immediate 24h nocturnal lull or emergency speed cap (e.g., USFD IMR flaw, broken wire, track circuit drop).
 99:   * **P2 (Scheduled / Periodicity Bound / Score 50–79):** Mandatory regulatory maintenance with scheduled deadline (e.g., track tamping, point machine overhaul). Bundled into 7-day rolling corridor.
100:   * **P3 (Preventive / Routine / Score 0–49):** Maintenance fitted into opportunistic shadow block windows (e.g., insulator washing, drain clearing).
101: 
102: ### 4.3 Module 3: Joint Shadow-Block Optimization Engine
103: * **Mathematical Solver:** Google OR-Tools CP-SAT (`cp_model.CpModel`) disjunctive interval scheduling.
104: * **Objective Function:**
105:   $$\min \quad \alpha \sum_{b \in \mathcal{B}} \text{Duration}(b) + \beta \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \Delta_{t}^{\text{delay}} + \gamma \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D}_{\text{deferred}}} \text{Risk}(d) - \delta \sum_{d_1, d_2 \in \text{Bundled}} \text{Synergy}(d_1, d_2)$$
106: * **Hard Operational Constraints:**
107:   * **Zero Passenger Cancellation:** No scheduled passenger trains may be cancelled or delayed beyond regulatory headway.
108:   * **Passenger Headway Adherence:** Minimum safety headways ($\Delta_{\text{clear}} \ge 15\text{ minutes}$) enforced between maintenance block termination and passenger train arrival.
109:   * **Co-Location Shadow Blocking:** Civil track gangs and S&T crews work underneath de-energized OHE windows ($\Delta_{\text{earth}} \ge 10\text{ min}$, $\Delta_{\text{restore}} \ge 10\text{ min}$).
110:   * **Resource Feasibility:** Maintenance gang, Tower Wagon, and track machine (CSM, BCM) availability bounds must be satisfied.
111: 
112: ### 4.4 Module 4: Multi-Horizon Planning
113: * **24-Hour Tactical Horizon:** 
114:   * Real-time slotting for upcoming nocturnal white corridor (01:30–04:30 AM).
115:   * Emergency P1 defect insertions and dynamic freight path re-routing.
116: * **7-Day Operational Horizon:**
117:   * Rolling corridor maintenance schedule bundling multi-department blocks.
118:   * CSM tamper and Tower Wagon depot coordination.
119: * **30-Day Strategic Horizon:**
120:   * Heavy track machine routing optimization.
121:   * Long-term Track Geometry Index (TGI) corridor recovery planning.
122: 
123: ### 4.5 Module 5: Modern Web Dispatcher Cockpit (Mintlify Light-Blue System)
124: * **Corridor Time-Distance String Chart (`CorridorStringChart.tsx`):**
125:   * X-axis: Time (00:00 to 24:00 hours).
126:   * Y-axis: Distance / Stations (e.g. CSMT $\to$ Dadar $\to$ Thane $\to$ Kalyan).
127:   * Diagonal lines represent train trajectories; colored shaded rectangular zones represent joint maintenance blocks.
128: * **Department Demand Queue (`IncidentQueue.tsx`):**
129:   * Displays pending TMS, SMMS, and TDMS demands with urgency badges, duration, and AI bundling recommendations.
130:   * One-click `[APPROVE & SANCTION BLOCK]` action.
131: * **KPI Strip (`KpiStrip.tsx`):**
132:   * 6 operational metrics: Active Corridor Blocks, Corridor Downtime Saved (38.4%), Track Asset Availability Index (96.2%), Pending Demands, White Corridor Headway Gap, Kavach TSRs Active.
133: * **Interlocking & Block Map (`InterlockingMap.tsx`):**
134:   * Real-time visual tracking of active blocks, occupied circuits, signal aspects ($S\text{-}12$, $S\text{-}14$), and temporary speed restrictions (TSR).
135: * **Explainable Decision Dossier Modal (`DecisionLogModal.tsx`):**
136:   * 4-step chronological audit timeline with SHA-256 seal, Form S&T/T-351 confirmation, Form T/409 caution record, and official RDSO Section 14B Safety Compliance certificate generation.
137: 
138: ---
139: 
140: ## 5. MoSCoW Feature Matrix
141: 
142: | Category | Features |
143: | :--- | :--- |
144: | **Must Have** | • Multi-Department Ingestion Normalizer (TMS, SMMS, TDMS, COA).<br/>• Google OR-Tools CP-SAT Joint Shadow-Block Optimization Engine.<br/>• Corridor Time-Distance String Chart UI.<br/>• Department Demand Queue with P1/P2/P3 Urgency Triage.<br/>• Multi-Horizon Planning Switcher (24h Tactical, 7D Operational, 30D Strategic).<br/>• Controller One-Click Sanction Gate with Kavach TSRMS & Form S&T/T-351 lockout. |
145: | **Should Have** | • Interactive Gantt string-chart zoom and pan.<br/>• Machine (CSM/Tower Wagon) roster constraint solver.<br/>• Real-time WebSocket updates for train path shifts.<br/>• Downloadable RDSO Section 14B Block Sanction Dossier PDF/JSON with Form T/409 Caution Order. |
146: | **Could Have** | • What-if scenario simulator (weather disruption impact on corridor availability).<br/>• Crew duty hours tracking for maintenance gangs. |
147: | **Won't Have** | • ❌ Passenger coach interior tracking or ticket booking integration.<br/>• ❌ Unbounded manual text block requests (everything is digital & constraint-checked). |
148: 
149: ---
150: 
151: ## 6. Success Metrics & Operational Impact
152: 
153: * **Corridor Downtime:** **35% to 50% reduction** in total blocked line hours via automated shadow blocking.
154: * **Asset Availability:** **+18% increase** in available network capacity.
155: * **Punctuality:** **Zero** passenger train cancellations and **<1.2%** secondary delay propagation.
156: * **Solver Performance:** Corridor schedules solved in **<30 seconds** for 100+ km sections.
157: * **Safety:** **100% digital dissemination** of Kavach TSRs with zero track gang collision incidents.
````

  8: interface IncidentQueueProps {

163:                             />
164:                           </span>
165:                         </span>
166:                       </div>
167:                     </div>

169:                   {/* Right Action Group */}
170:                   <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 self-end md:self-center">
171:                     <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold rounded">

173:                     </span>
174:                     {currentStatus === 'PENDING_APPROVAL' && (

176:                         onClick={(e) => handleApprove(e, item.incidentId)}
177:                         className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-[#2B7FFF] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded hover:bg-blue-600 active:bg-blue-700 transition-all shadow-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5"
178:                         style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
179:                       >

186:                     {currentStatus === 'EXECUTING' && (

188:                         <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
189:                           <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" />
190:                         </svg>
191:                         <span>EXECUTING...</span>
192:                       </span>
193:                     )}
194:                     {currentStatus === 'RESOLVED' && (
195:                       <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded flex items-center space-x-1" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
196:                         <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
197:                           <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 10 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
198:                         </svg>
199:                         <span>APPROVED / RESOLVED</span>
200:                       </span>
201:                     )}
202:                     {currentStatus === 'REJECTED' && (
203:                       <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
204:                         REJECTED
205:                       </span>
206:                     )}
207:                   </div>
208:                 </div>
209:               );
210:             })
211:           )}
212:         </div>
213:       </div>
214:     </Card>
215:   );
216: };

  1: // src/components/Overview/InterlockingMap.tsx
  2: 'use client';
  3: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
  4: import { Card } from '../Common/Card';
  5: import { SignalHead } from '../Common/SignalHead';

  9: export interface InterlockingMapProps {
 10:   circuits?: TrackCircuitState[];
 11:   selectedCircuitId?: string;
 12:   selectedTrackId?: string;
 13:   onTrackSelect?: (circuitId: string) => void;
 14:   onSignalClick?: (signalId: string, currentAspect: SignalAspect) => void;
 15:   onToggleClamp?: (circuitId: string) => void;
 16: }
 17: // Bi-directional normalizer between legacy BLK IDs and standard TC-01..06 IDs
 18: const normalizeCircuitId = (id?: string): string => {
 19:   if (!id) return 'TC-03';
 20:   const mapping: Record<string, string> = {
 21:     'BLK-101': 'TC-01',
 22:     'BLK-102': 'TC-02',
 23:     'BLK-103': 'TC-03',
 24:     'BLK-104': 'TC-04',
 25:     'BLK-105': 'TC-05'
 26:   };
 27:   return mapping[id] || id;
 28: };
 29: const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CIRCUIT: TrackCircuitState = {
 30:   circuitId: 'TC-03',
 31:   trackLine: 'UP_SLOW',
 32:   stationName: 'Dadar - Kurla',
 33:   kmStart: 9.2,
 34:   kmEnd: 15.5,
 35:   status: 'BLOCK_SANCTIONED',
 36:   signalId: 'S-12',
 37:   signalAspect: 'RED',
 38:   isSignalClamped: true,
 39:   speedLimitKmh: 30,
 40:   oheEnergized: false
 41: };
 42: export const InterlockingMap: React.FC<InterlockingMapProps> = ({
 43:   circuits = MOCK_TRACK_CIRCUITS,
 44:   selectedCircuitId,
 45:   selectedTrackId,
 46:   onTrackSelect,
 47:   onSignalClick,
 48:   onToggleClamp
 49: }) => {
 50:   const [activeSwitch, setActiveSwitch] = useState<'NORMAL' | 'REVERSE'>('NORMAL');
 51:   const [internalSelectedId, setInternalSelectedId] = useState<string>(
 52:     normalizeCircuitId(selectedCircuitId || selectedTrackId)
 53:   );
 54:   const [localCircuits, setLocalCircuits] = useState<TrackCircuitState[]>(
 55:     circuits && circuits.length > 0 ? circuits : MOCK_TRACK_CIRCUITS
 56:   );
 57:   // Sync state when upstream props change (Avoids State Stall)
 58:   useEffect(() => {
 59:     if (circuits && circuits.length > 0) {
 60:       setLocalCircuits(circuits);
 61:     }
 62:   }, [circuits]);
 63:   useEffect(() => {
 64:     const nextNormalized = normalizeCircuitId(selectedCircuitId || selectedTrackId);
 65:     if (nextNormalized) {
 66:       setInternalSelectedId(nextNormalized);
 67:     }
 68:   }, [selectedCircuitId, selectedTrackId]);
 69:   const activeId = normalizeCircuitId(selectedCircuitId || selectedTrackId || internalSelectedId);
 70:   const currentCircuit =
 71:     localCircuits.find((c) => c.circuitId === activeId) ||
 72:     localCircuits[0] ||
 73:     DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CIRCUIT;
 74:   const handleSelectTrack = (circuitId: string) => {
 75:     setInternalSelectedId(circuitId);
 76:     if (onTrackSelect) onTrackSelect(circuitId);
 77:   };
 78:   const handleToggleLocalClamp = (circuitId: string) => {
 79:     setLocalCircuits((prev) =>
 80:       prev.map((c) => {
 81:         if (c.circuitId === circuitId) {
 82:           const nextClamped = !c.isSignalClamped;
 83:           return {
 84:             ...c,
 85:             isSignalClamped: nextClamped,
 86:             // Fail-safe transition: Clamped = RED; Release = YELLOW (Caution approach under GR 3.08)
 87:             signalAspect: nextClamped ? 'RED' : 'YELLOW',
 88:             status: nextClamped ? 'BLOCK_SANCTIONED' : 'MAINTENANCE_SLOTTED',
 89:             oheEnergized: !nextClamped,
 90:             speedLimitKmh: nextClamped ? 30 : Math.min(c.speedLimitKmh, 50)
 91:           };
 92:         }
 93:         return c;
 94:       })
 95:     );
 96:     if (onToggleClamp) onToggleClamp(circuitId);
 97:   };
 98:   const handleLocalSignalClick = (signalId: string, currentAspect: SignalAspect) => {
 99:     setLocalCircuits((prev) =>
100:       prev.map((c) => {
101:         if (c.signalId === signalId && !c.isSignalClamped) {
102:           let nextAspect: SignalAspect = 'GREEN';
103:           if (currentAspect === 'GREEN') nextAspect = 'YELLOW';
104:           else if (currentAspect === 'YELLOW') nextAspect = 'DOUBLE_YELLOW';
105:           else if (currentAspect === 'DOUBLE_YELLOW') nextAspect = 'RED';
106:           else nextAspect = 'GREEN';
107:           return { ...c, signalAspect: nextAspect };
108:         }
109:         return c;
110:       })
111:     );
112:     if (onSignalClick) onSignalClick(signalId, currentAspect);
113:   };
114:   const getStatusBadge = (status: CircuitOperationalStatus) => {

146:   );
147:   return (

 68:   onSelectScenario: (scenario: TacticalScenario) => void;
 69:   onTriggerBraking: () => void;
 70:   onResetSimulation: () => void;
 71:   brakeState: 'CLEAR' | 'EMERGENCY_SOLENOID_ACTUATED';
 72:   isExecuting: boolean;
 73:   currentSpeedKmh: number;
 74:   brakePressureBar: number;
 75:   deploymentMode: DeploymentMode;
 76:   activeStage: number;
 77:   weatherCondition?: WeatherCondition;
 78:   onWeatherChange?: (weather: WeatherCondition) => void;
 79:   cameraAngle?: TacticalCameraAngle;
 80:   onCameraAngleChange?: (angle: TacticalCameraAngle) => void;
 81: }
 82: export const LocoCameraFeed: React.FC<LocoCameraFeedProps> = ({
 83:   currentScenario,
 84:   onSelectScenario,
 85:   onTriggerBraking,
 86:   onResetSimulation,
 87:   brakeState,
 88:   isExecuting,
 89:   currentSpeedKmh,
 90:   brakePressureBar,
 91:   deploymentMode,
 92:   activeStage,
 93:   weatherCondition = 'DRY',
 94:   onWeatherChange,
 95:   cameraAngle = 'FORWARD_CAB',
 96:   onCameraAngleChange
 97: }) => {
 98:   const [internalWeather, setInternalWeather] = useState<WeatherCondition>(weatherCondition);
 99:   const [internalAngle, setInternalAngle] = useState<TacticalCameraAngle>(cameraAngle);
100:   const activeWeather = onWeatherChange ? weatherCondition : internalWeather;
101:   const activeAngle = onCameraAngleChange ? cameraAngle : internalAngle;
102:   const handleWeatherSelect = (w: WeatherCondition) => {
103:     if (onWeatherChange) onWeatherChange(w);
104:     else setInternalWeather(w);
105:   };
106:   const handleAngleSelect = (a: TacticalCameraAngle) => {
107:     if (onCameraAngleChange) onCameraAngleChange(a);
108:     else setInternalAngle(a);
109:   };
110:   const isEmergency = brakeState === 'EMERGENCY_SOLENOID_ACTUATED';
111:   const isStopped = currentSpeedKmh === 0 && isEmergency;
112:   const weatherInfo = getWeatherFrictionParams(activeWeather);
113:   // Auxiliary live feeds remain video; the forward cab is the supplied local POV.
114:   const videoUrls: Record<TacticalCameraAngle, string> = {
115:     FORWARD_CAB: 'https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-train-passing-through-a-green-landscape-42211-large.mp4',
116:     OHE_PANTOGRAPH: 'https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-aerial-view-of-a-cargo-train-running-on-tracks-42214-large.mp4',
117:     BOGIE_UNDERCARRIAGE: 'https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-cargo-train-running-on-railroad-tracks-42215-large.mp4'
118:   };
119:   return (
120:     <Card
121:       title={`Tactical Multi-Sensor Telemetry & Vision Feed (Cab #204 — ${currentScenario.trainId})`}
122:       className="mb-6"
123:     >
124:       {/* Scenario Switcher Toolbar */}
125:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#D0DFEE]">
126:         <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
127:           <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0F172A]">TACTICAL SCENARIO:</span>
128:           <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
129:             {Object.values(SCENARIOS).map((sc) => {
130:               const isSelected = sc.key === currentScenario.key;
131:               return (
132:                 <button
133:                   key={sc.key}
134:                   disabled={isExecuting && activeStage > 0 && activeStage < 5}
135:                   onClick={() => onSelectScenario(sc)}
136:                   className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium border transition-all ${
137:                     isSelected
138:                       ? 'bg-[#2B7FFF] text-white border-[#2B7FFF] shadow-xs'
139:                       : 'bg-white text-[#0F172A] border-[#D0DFEE] hover:bg-[#F0F6FC]'
140:                   } disabled:opacity-50`}
141:                   style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
142:                 >
143:                   {sc.title}
144:                 </button>
145:               );
146:             })}
147:           </div>
148:         </div>
149:         {/* Mode & Section Badge */}
150:         <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
151:           <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#F0F6FC] border border-[#D0DFEE] text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-700 rounded" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
152:             {currentScenario.trackSection}
153:           </span>
154:           <span
155:             className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold border rounded ${
156:               deploymentMode === 'ADVISORY'
157:                 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-300'
158:                 : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300'
159:             }`}
160:             style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
161:           >
162:             {deploymentMode === 'ADVISORY' ? '⚠️ ADVISORY' : '⚡ AUTONOMOUS'}
163:           </span>
164:         </div>
165:       </div>
166:       {/* Sub-Toolbar: Multi-Angle Sensor Feeds & Environmental Friction Selector */}
167:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-[#D0DFEE]">
168:         {/* Camera Angle Selector */}
169:         <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
170:           <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Camera Angle:</span>
171:           <div className="flex space-x-1 bg-[#F0F6FC] p-0.5 border border-[#D0DFEE]" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
172:             <button
173:               onClick={() => handleAngleSelect('FORWARD_CAB')}
174:               className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold transition-all ${
175:                 activeAngle === 'FORWARD_CAB' ? 'bg-[#2B7FFF] text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
176:               }`}
177:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
178:             >
179:               🎥 Forward Cab
180:             </button>
181:             <button
182:               onClick={() => handleAngleSelect('OHE_PANTOGRAPH')}
183:               className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold transition-all ${
184:                 activeAngle === 'OHE_PANTOGRAPH' ? 'bg-[#2B7FFF] text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
185:               }`}
186:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
187:             >
188:               ⚡ OHE Pantograph
189:             </button>
190:             <button
191:               onClick={() => handleAngleSelect('BOGIE_UNDERCARRIAGE')}
192:               className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold transition-all ${
193:                 activeAngle === 'BOGIE_UNDERCARRIAGE' ? 'bg-[#2B7FFF] text-white shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
194:               }`}
195:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
196:             >
197:               🛤️ Undercarriage
198:             </button>
199:           </div>
200:         </div>
201:         {/* Environmental Weather Simulator */}
202:         <div className="flex items-center justify-start md:justify-end space-x-2">
203:           <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Weather / Track:</span>
204:           <div className="flex space-x-1 bg-[#F0F6FC] p-0.5 border border-[#D0DFEE]" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
205:             <button
206:               onClick={() => handleWeatherSelect('DRY')}
207:               className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium transition-all ${
208:                 activeWeather === 'DRY' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 font-bold border border-amber-300 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
209:               }`}
210:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
211:               title="Clear dry track (mu = 0.134)"
212:             >
213:               ☀️ Dry
214:             </button>
215:             <button
216:               onClick={() => handleWeatherSelect('WET_MONSOON')}
217:               className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium transition-all ${
218:                 activeWeather === 'WET_MONSOON' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 font-bold border border-blue-300 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
219:               }`}
220:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
221:               title="Heavy Monsoon slippage (mu = 0.095, +35% stopping distance)"
222:             >
223:               🌧️ Monsoon
224:             </button>
225:             <button
226:               onClick={() => handleWeatherSelect('DENSE_FOG')}
227:               className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium transition-all ${
228:                 activeWeather === 'DENSE_FOG' ? 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-bold border border-slate-400 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
229:               }`}
230:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
231:               title="Severe Winter Fog (mu = 0.115, sight limited)"
232:             >
233:               🌫️ Fog
234:             </button>
235:             <button
236:               onClick={() => handleWeatherSelect('NIGHT_IR')}
237:               className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium transition-all ${
238:                 activeWeather === 'NIGHT_IR' ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-900 font-bold border border-purple-300 shadow-xs' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-white'
239:               }`}
240:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
241:               title="Night Vision Infrared (Thermal Spectral)"
242:             >
243:               🌙 IR Night
244:             </button>
245:           </div>
246:         </div>
247:       </div>
248:       {/* Main Video & HUD Viewport */}
249:       <div className={`relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 min-h-[420px] flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner ${
250:         activeWeather === 'NIGHT_IR' ? 'filter hue-rotate-90 saturate-200 contrast-125' : activeWeather === 'DENSE_FOG' ? 'contrast-75 brightness-95' : ''
251:       }`}>
252:         {/* Forward vision uses the supplied locomotive cab point-of-view image. */}
253:         {activeAngle === 'FORWARD_CAB' ? (
254:           <img
255:             src={scenarioImageUrls[currentScenario.key]}
256:             alt={`${currentScenario.hazardClass.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ')} detection from locomotive cab`}
257:             className="w-full h-[420px] object-cover opacity-90"
258:           />
259:         ) : (
260:           <video
261:             key={activeAngle}
262:             src={videoUrls[activeAngle]}
263:             autoPlay
264:             loop
265:             muted
266:             playsInline
267:             className="w-full h-[420px] object-cover opacity-90"
268:           />
269:         )}
270:         {/* Environmental Rain Overlay */}
271:         {activeWeather === 'WET_MONSOON' && (
272:           <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none bg-blue-900/15 backdrop-blur-[0.5px]" />
273:         )}
274:         {/* Environmental Fog Overlay */}
275:         {activeWeather === 'DENSE_FOG' && (
276:           <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none bg-slate-200/25 backdrop-blur-[1px]" />
277:         )}
278:         {/* HTML5 Overlay Grid & Crosshairs */}
279:         <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-20 bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#ffffff15_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#ffffff15_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:40px_40px]" />
280:         {/* Dynamic Bounding Box Overlay for Selected Hazard (Only on Forward Cab) */}
281:         {activeAngle === 'FORWARD_CAB' && (
282:           <div
283:             className={`absolute border-2 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between shadow-lg ${
284:               currentScenario.hazardClass === 'CATTLE'
285:                 ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-500/20'
286:                 : 'border-red-500 bg-red-500/20'
287:             } ${activeStage >= 1 ? 'ring-4 ring-red-400/50 animate-pulse' : ''}`}
288:             style={{
289:               top: currentScenario.boxStyle.top,
290:               left: currentScenario.boxStyle.left,
291:               width: currentScenario.boxStyle.width,
292:               height: currentScenario.boxStyle.height,
293:               borderRadius: '4px'
294:             }}
295:           >
296:             <div
297:               className={`text-white text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 w-max rounded-t-sm shadow ${
298:                 currentScenario.hazardClass === 'CATTLE' ? 'bg-amber-600' : 'bg-red-600'
299:               }`}
300:             >
301:               {currentScenario.badgeLabel}
302:             </div>
303:             <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-white/90 bg-black/75 px-1 py-0.5 rounded-b-sm flex justify-between">
304:               <span>{currentScenario.hazardClass}</span>
305:               <span className="text-emerald-300 font-bold">{Math.round(currentScenario.confidence * 100)}% CONF</span>
306:             </div>
307:           </div>
308:         )}
309:         {/* Pantograph / Catenary HUD Annotation (When OHE Angle selected) */}
310:         {activeAngle === 'OHE_PANTOGRAPH' && (
311:           <div className="absolute top-1/3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border border-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/20 p-2 text-cyan-200 font-mono text-xs rounded" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
312:             ⚡ CATENARY CONTACT: 25.4 kV AC | WIRE TENSION: 10.2 kN (NORMAL)
313:           </div>
314:         )}
315:         {/* Bogie / Undercarriage HUD Annotation (When Undercarriage selected) */}
316:         {activeAngle === 'BOGIE_UNDERCARRIAGE' && (
317:           <div className="absolute bottom-1/3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/20 p-2 text-emerald-200 font-mono text-xs rounded" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
318:             🛤️ AXLE VIBRATION: 1.8 mm/s RMS | WHEEL FLANGE TEMP: 42°C (NOMINAL)
319:           </div>
320:         )}
321:         {/* HUD Telemetry Overlay (Top Left) */}
322:         <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20 p-3.5 text-white font-mono text-xs space-y-1.5 shadow-2xl rounded" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
323:           <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 border-b border-white/10 pb-1">
324:             <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
325:             <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold tracking-tight">
326:               {activeAngle === 'FORWARD_CAB' ? 'CAM: LOCO-CAB-FRONT-VANDB-204' : activeAngle === 'OHE_PANTOGRAPH' ? 'CAM: OHE-PANTOGRAPH-ROOF-01' : 'CAM: BOGIE-OPTICAL-AXLE-04'}
327:             </span>
328:           </div>
329:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[11px] pt-0.5">
330:             <div>SPEED: <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold text-sm">{currentSpeedKmh}</span> KM/H</div>
331:             <div>BRAKE CYL: <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold text-sm">{brakePressureBar.toFixed(1)}</span> BAR</div>
332:             <div>DISTANCE: <span className="text-red-300 font-bold">{currentScenario.distanceMeters}</span> M</div>
333:             <div>CONDITIONS: <span className="text-yellow-200 font-bold">{weatherInfo.label}</span></div>
334:           </div>
335:           <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
336:             <span>SOLENOID STATE:</span>
337:             <span
338:               className={`font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] ${
339:                 isEmergency ? 'bg-red-600 text-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-emerald-800 text-emerald-100'
340:               }`}
341:               style={{ borderRadius: '2px' }}
342:             >
343:               {brakeState}
344:             </span>
345:           </div>
346:         </div>
347:         {/* Speed & Brake Status Gauge (Top Right) */}
348:         <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20 p-3 text-right font-mono text-xs rounded shadow-2xl" style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}>
349:           <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Kinematic Status</div>
350:           <div className={`text-base font-bold ${isStopped ? 'text-red-400' : isEmergency ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}`}>
351:             {isStopped ? '🛑 FULL STOP (SAFE)' : isEmergency ? '⚠️ DECELERATING (EBD ACTIVE)' : '🟢 CRUISING (CLEAR)'}
352:           </div>
353:           <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
354:             Friction: <span className="text-white font-bold">μ = {weatherInfo.frictionCoefficient}</span> | Grade: <span className="text-white font-bold">+0.002</span>
355:           </div>
356:           <div className="text-[9px] text-amber-300 font-bold mt-0.5">
357:             {weatherInfo.riskFactor}
358:           </div>
359:         </div>
360:         {/* Action Controls Overlay (Bottom Right) */}
361:         <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 flex items-center space-x-2">
362:           {isEmergency && (
363:             <button
364:               onClick={onResetSimulation}
365:               className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white text-xs font-bold border border-slate-600 shadow-lg transition-all"
366:               style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
367:             >
368:               🔄 [RESET SIMULATION]
369:             </button>
370:           )}
371:           <button
372:             onClick={onTriggerBraking}
373:             disabled={isExecuting && activeStage > 0 && activeStage < 5}
374:             className={`px-4 py-2.5 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xl border transition-all ${
375:               isEmergency
376:                 ? 'bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500'
377:                 : 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 border-red-400'
378:             } disabled:opacity-50`}
379:             style={{ borderRadius: '4px' }}
380:           >
381:             {isEmergency ? '⚡ [RE-EVALUATE KAVACH PIPELINE]' : '🚨 [RUN 4-AGENT KAVACH PIPELINE]'}
382:           </button>
383:         </div>
384:       </div>
385:     </Card>
386:   );
387: };
````
